Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott 

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to: 

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of. 

Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year. 

An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution 

Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree. 

A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune. 

A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists. 

The Opportunity 

This position will have overall Tech Ops responsibility for Operational Excellence work streams, including Functional Excellence and Organizational Excellence. The Operational Excellence Leader will be responsible for leading and driving the principle-based behaviors within Tech Ops which include: Creating value for our business and customers, accountability and ownership at all levels, integration and inclusiveness within R&D, focusing on the process, embracing data & facts, do it right the first time, leading by example and respect for all. It is through these pillars; the Operational Excellence Leader will be responsible for the identification, management and execution of projects and improve processes within Tech Ops which will deliver year-over-year improvements. The Operational Excellence Leader will be the catalyst within Tech Ops to appropriately, and respectfully, challenge status quo which will continually drive improvements via best practice replication (learning from within the network and externally), creative and innovative solutions, alignment of goals and objectives and resource planning to deliver results. 

This person will be responsible for defining, evolving, and embedding effective operating models, process standards, and continuous improvement practices across Tech Ops. This role improves organizational effectiveness by standardizing interaction models, clarifying decision rights, optimizing value streams, and enabling disciplined execution across Device, Sensor, and Digital functions. This role integrates Lean, Agile, and hybrid methodologies within a regulated technical environment to improve delivery reliability, quality, and speed. 

What You'll Do

Lead organization’s capability in knowledge and understanding of metrics and measurements which impact the total performance of Tech Ops. 

Drive visual management and data understanding throughout Tech Ops facilities. 

Manage and facilitate continuous improvement projects in support of company objectives. 

Develops an implementation plan, conducts risk assessments and develops contingency plans to accommodate unforeseen events. 

Recognizes and removes barriers to project completion. 

Recognizes the broader implications of actions and proposals on the overall business. 

Mentor/train key stakeholders in the use and practice of continuous improvement methodologies and tools. (Lean, value stream mapping, six-sigma, Kaizen). Assesses current processes and standard work flow and identifies process improvement opportunities utilizing organizational, analytical, Lean and six sigma problem solving methodologies. 

Assist in selecting, scoping and prioritizing continuous improvement projects across the business ·Plans and facilitates the execution of various value stream mapping and Kaizen events. 

Estimates and verifies financial benefits from continuous improvement projects. 

Acts as a change agent by communicating the enterprise-wide changes to the employees and helping them to learn, understand, adjust and grow within the continuous improvement culture. 

Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed. 

Participates as a key business partner to the leadership team. 

Contributes to business strategy development and operational execution of business plans. 

Helps to create the future state as it relates to shortened value streams, Tech Ops strategies, cross-functional processes, and the establishment of uniform policies and procedures. 

Develops programs and initiatives that support the business strategies and plans. 

Thinks strategically to anticipate future issues and challenges and create appropriate plans now, using proactive approaches. 

Demonstrates analytical capability to find systemic issues to root cause, and crest actions plant to mitigate, close and/or eliminate. 

Develop toolkits, templates, and guidance materials to enable consistent ways of working across teams. 

Monitor adoption of standardized processes and provide feedback to the Director on systemic improvement opportunities. 

Partner with Change Management to support adoption of new processes and practices. 

Identify operational friction points and recommend improvements to Business Excellence leadership 

Lead high value projects within Tech Ops functions and sites and effectively coordinate projects with the deployment champion and other improvement project teams. 

This includes identification of opportunities, definition of done and financial justification of projects, stakeholder management, change management, project team resource management, overall project/program management, lead teams to execute projects with sound problem solving methodology, track project and program status and results, remove and elevate project barriers, and develop team members. 

It is also critical to identify integration points across the project value stream projects/processes and coordinate the improvements with key stakeholders and process owners to maximize project/program value delivery. 

Manage the development and maintenance of methods and enabling systems (including governance, organizational structures, processes and tools) that accurately demonstrate the degree to which the project/program goals, objectives and metrics are being met. 

Provide deployment champion with the results and recommend appropriate corrective action. 

Address program requirements necessary to support constantly changing priorities, responsibilities and organizational ambiguities. 

Recruit Experts, Advocates and Team Members into the Business Excellence infrastructure, and ensure continuing development of their skills. 

Sound stakeholder management and change management: This includes keeping the Deployment Champion, Tech Ops staff and R&D management informed of program status and ensuring coordination of activities between Black Belts at other facilities inside and outside of Tech Ops. 

Best Practice Sharing: As a global lean leader, this position will drive replication of applicable best practices and learnings across sites, organizations and the division functions. 

Take an active role in educating stakeholders on BEx methodologies and participate in multi-divisional councils that shape the future of Business Excellence at Abbott. 

Operates with general direction and minimal supervision from the Director, Business Excellence and has full responsibility to make decisions that directly impact margin project financial achievement.

Experience You'll Bring

Required

Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business, Engineering, Technical or Science or extensive equivalent experience

Minimum of 10 years related work experience

8-10 years of demonstrated success in applying Continuous Improvement / BEx tools

2 - 5 years’ experience in business improvement, quality systems or other areas related to the project with an understanding of Abbott internal systems and procedures. 

Preferred

Certification or equivalent working knowledge of improvement tools and methodologies Lean/Six Sigma; Black belt preferred. Knowledge of applicable regulatory standards and requirements for FDA regulated environment. Knowledge of cost accounting/financial reporting systems. 

Has successfully led several high complexity projects from beginning to end. Demonstrated technical skills and management judgment appropriate to the project. Demonstrated expertise in PM tools and processes.

Willingness to travel (to facilitate personal development and support of other sites).

Demonstrated diplomacy and effective functioning and communication in a matrix environment.

Ability to organize and lead cross functional teams and align team members to management's vision.

Excellent interpersonal skills, demonstrated ability to effectively lead in a team environment, adaptable to change, able to manage competing priorities, excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent written and verbal communication skills and sense of business savvy.

Ability to make critical decisions in a fast-paced production environment.

Solicits the cooperation of a diverse group of disciplines and functions in a tactful and persuasive manner. 

PMP certification and/or MBA is a plus

Apply Now

Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Main Purpose of the Role

Provides support to the Manufacturing organization to facilitate efficient operations within the production area, to optimize existing processes, and to ensure that production goals are met. Monitors performance of equipment, machines and tools and corrects equipment problems or process parameters that produce non-conforming products, low yields or product quality issues. Interfaces with Quality and Research and Development organizations to integrate new products or processes into the existing manufacturing area.

Main Responsibilities

Initiates and completes technical activities leading to new or improved products or process, for current programs, next generation programs and to meet strategic goals and objectives of the company.

Prepares reports, publishes, and makes presentations to communicate findings.

Analyzes and solves problems from basic engineering principles, theories and concepts through to a wide range of complex and advanced problems which require novel and new innovative approaches or a major breakthrough in technology.

Apply standard engineering principles and methodologies to interpret problems; create/modify designs; draw conclusions and recommend options for solutions;

Understands engineering principles theories, concepts, practices and techniques. Develops knowledge in a field to become a recognized leader or authority in an area of specialization and applies this knowledge in leadership roles in the company.

Incorporates business policies and procedures into task completion. Responsible for completing documentation in a timely manner and in accordance with business standards;

Understands the business needs of the company, and has knowledge of the customer needs of our business.

Understands the business cycle and foresight of emerging technologies trends.

Responsible for implementing and maintaining the effectiveness of the Quality System.

Cultivates internal and external network of resources to complete tasks.

Serves has a resource in the selection orientation and training of new engineers and employees.

May lead a project team, determining goals and objectives for the projects.

Execute work instruction updates to ensure that documents accurately reflect the current process.

Mentors employees by sharing technical expertise and providing feedback and guidance.

Interacts cross functionally and with internal and external customers.

Serves as a consultant for engineering or scientific interpretations and advice on significant matters.

Acts as a spokesperson to customers on business unit current and future capabilities.

Cultivates a wide range of internal networks and begins to develop an extensive external network of resources to facilitate completion of tasks.

Strong project management skills. Provides guidance to less experienced staff. Acts as a mentor to lower level individual contributors.

Influence exerted at peer level and occasionally at first levels of management.

Plans, organizes, and prioritizes own daily work routine to meet established schedule.

Responsible for writing and evaluating process, equipment, and non-product software qualifications.

Exercises authority and judgment within defined limits to determine appropriate action.

Failure to achieve results or erroneous decisions or recommendations may cause delays in program schedules and may result in the allocation of additional resources.

REQUIREMENTS

Working technical knowledge and application of concepts, practices and procedures. 

General understanding of business unit/group function. 

Will perform this job in a quality system environment. Failure to adequately perform tasks can result in noncompliance with governmental regulations.

Works on problems of moderate scope where analysis of situations or data requires a review of identifiable factors. 

Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action.

Has a broad knowledge of technical alternatives and an understanding of their impact on the systems environment.

Must possess strong technical writing capability, with the ability to produce clear and accurate engineering documents, technical reports, qualification protocols, troubleshooting guides, and cross‑functional communication materials.

Must perform validation activities for the distribution center, including developing and executing process and equipment qualification protocols, documenting objective evidence, resolving deviations, and ensuring adherence to Quality System and regulatory standards.

Must create and maintain SOPs and Work Instructions, ensuring that procedures accurately represent current operational practices; must manage revisions through formal document control processes and support training impact assessments to maintain quality and safety compliance.

Must function effectively in a fast‑paced, high‑urgency environment, demonstrating responsiveness, real‑time problem‑solving capability, and the ability to support uninterrupted operations and high‑volume daily targets.

Must have experience with Windchill or a similar Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) platform, including navigating document control workflows, managing engineering changes, reviewing controlled documents, and ensuring accurate configuration and revision management within the Quality System.

Minimum 2 years

2-5 years of related work experience with a good understanding of specified functional area.

Bachelors Degree (± 16 years)

Related field.

OR

An equivalent combination of education and work experience

Masters Degree (± 18 years)

Preferred

Senior Clinical Research Scientist

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity 

This position works out of our St. Paul, MN or Plymouth, MN location in the Electrophysiology division. In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

As the Senior Clinical Research Scientist you will lead scientific activities associated with the design, conduct, and reporting of clinical trials for this therapeutic area. This position will participate in the development of clinical evidence to establish feasibility, achieve regulatory approvals, meet ongoing regulatory requirements, gain reimbursement, and support full commercial adoption of medical devices. You will support the analysis and interpretation of scientific data and write clinical study protocols, reports, and scientific publications. You will aid in the production of additional study-level documents including informed consent forms, case report forms, and investigator brochures. In this role, you will interact with physician Key Opinion Leaders and various cross-functional teams, including Marketing, R&D, Field Operations, Risk Management, Reimbursement, Medical Affairs, Quality, and Regulatory Affairs. You will also interact with global regulatory agencies to obtain market approval of new products, and with study sites to respond to questions throughout the study.

What You’ll Work On

Participate in clinical trial design, protocol development, and publication planning.

Generate and execute study-level publication projects.

Prepare clinical study reports or report sections.

Support regulatory submissions.

Facilitate communication between Sales and Marketing, R&D, Program Management, Reimbursement, Medical Affairs, Risk Management, Quality and Regulatory Affairs, and investigational sites.

Oversee study Steering Committees and Publication Committees, consisting of physician Key Opinion Leaders globally.

Present clinical study results to senior leaders and at investigator meetings.

Participate in and support audits.

Required Qualifications

Advanced degree in the sciences, medicine, or similar discipline.

4+ years of clinical research work experience post-degree. 

Demonstrated scientific writing ability.

Ability to plan and organize project assignments of substantial variety and complexity.

Ability to be innovative, resourceful, and work with minimal direction.

Excellent organization, problem solving, and communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

Ability to work within a team and as an individual contributor in a fast-paced, changing environment.

Strong verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization.

Strong organizational and follow-up skills, as well as attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the medical device industry.

Experience with international medical device regulations and submissions.

Familiarity with relevant international regulatory requirements for medical devices including Quality Systems standards and clinical investigations.

Experience working in a quality system environment preferred.

The Opportunity 

This position works out of our Santa Clara, CA or Plymouth, MN location in our Structural Heart Division. In Abbott’s Structural Heart (SH) business, our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life by designing and providing device and management solutions for treating structural heart disease.

As the Administrative Assistant, you will provide advanced administrative support to one or more Divisional Vice Presidents and other managers/directors as assigned. May provide backup support to higher-level management as needed.

Consistently interacts with high-level leadership.

Exhibits extraordinary attention to detail, critical thinking, adaptability and integrity.

Maintains and manages calendars, including meeting and travel scheduling and domestic and international travel arrangements.

Proactively identifies and resolves scheduling conflicts.

Adheres to processes and guidelines

Acerca de Abbott
 
Abbott es líder mundial en cuidado de la salud, creando ciencia innovadora para mejorar la salud de las personas. Siempre estamos mirando hacia el futuro, anticipando cambios en la ciencia y la tecnología médica.

Una compañía que es reconocida como una de las mejores empresas grandes para trabajar para las madres trabajadoras, mujeres ejecutivas y científicas y donde se valora la diversidad.

 
La Oportunidad

Esta posición está ubicada en Santo Domingo, Republica Dominicana, en la división Productos Farmacéuticos Establecidos (EPD). Estamos comprometidos a llevar los beneficios de nuestros medicamentos confiables a más personas en los países de más rápido crecimiento del mundo. Nuestro amplio portafolio de medicamentos genéricos de marca diferenciada y de alta calidad abarca múltiples áreas terapéuticas, incluidas la gastroenterología, la salud de la mujer, los cardio metabólicos, el manejo del dolor / sistema nervioso central y las vías respiratorias.

Responsable de realizar mensualmente promoción Omnicanal con el mensaje y la frecuencia correctos a los médicos de su territorio de trabajo, con el fin de incrementar las ventas de los productos a cargo. EDTS – en del av Abbott

European Drug Testing Service (EDTS) AB startade sin verksamhet 1991 inom området slumpvisa drogtester på arbetsplatsen. Idag ingår EDTS i Abbott koncernen och vi är med våra fyra affärsområden ett ledande drogtestföretag i Norden. Förutom genomförande av drogtester på arbetsplatser, bistår vi vårdföretag med administrativa tjänster och digitala lösningar inom drogtestning och laboratorieanalyser.

Vi säljer och förmedlar även högkvalitativa produkter för drogtestning, bl.a. screeningstester (POCT) i saliv och urin, instrument för drogtestning, alkometrar samt reagenser.

Våra kunder finns bl.a. inom kommun och landsting, arbetsgivare och företagshälsovård, laboratorier, privata vårdgivare samt skolor. Vår företagskultur präglas av kvalitet, trygghet och innovation samt en fortsatt ambition att i nära samarbete med våra samarbetspartners och kunder driva utvecklingen i branschen.

EDTS växer och med ökat kundantal samt med utveckling av vårt tjänsteutbud behöver vi vara fler provtagare som fortsätter ge våra kunder bästa tänkbara service.

Just nu söker vi Provtagare i Mora/ Malung med omnejd, med start så snabbt som möjligt!

Som provtagare hos EDTS arbetar du självständigt med att utföra slumpvisa alkohol- och drogtester hos våra kunder som är arbetsgivare. Arbetet som provtagare ska ses som ett komplement till ditt ordinarie arbete. I rollen ingår att du skall kunna arbeta på oregelbundna arbetstider även kvällar, nätter samt helger. I rollen som provtagare utgår du från ditt hem och du har stor möjlighet att själv planera dina pass under en månad.

Som provtagare har du ett stort personligt ansvar och har nära samarbete med dina kollegor på huvudkontoret i Kista.

ANSVAR:

Du ansvarar för att självständigt boka in dina uppdrag hos vår kunder i enlighet med gällande rutiner

Genomföra alkohol- och drogtest (via saliv eller urin) i enlighet med Chain of Custody

Genomföra utbildningar som är tilldelade dig och närvara på obligatoriska möten via Teams

Hålla utbildningar för nya provtagare vid behov

KVALIFIKATIONER OCH UTBILDNING:

Minimum undersköterska eller BMA

Du måste ha körkort och egen bil

Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift

Du bor i Mora/ Malung eller i närheten.

FÖREDRAGNA KVALIFIKATIONER

Erfarenhet av företagshälsovård och/eller laboratorietjänster

Erfarenhet av att utbilda andra

KOMPETENS:

Utmärkt kommunikativ förmåga

Strukturerad och noggrann

Hög ansvarskänsla och serviceinriktad inställning

Måste visa starkt eget driv

Du ska kunna arbeta självständigt

God systemvana

HUR MAN SÖKER:

Är du intresserad av att jobba som provtagare hos EDTS så ber vi dig ansöka med ditt CV och personliga brev och ev foto via Workday. 

I ditt personliga brev önskar vi även att du har besvarat nedanstående frågor då detta är ett extra arbete till ditt ordinarie arbete. 

Har du idag möjlighet att lägga ditt eget schema? 

Kan du tänka dig att arbeta även kvällar, nätter och helger?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Stage bij Abbott in Olst

Ben jij een ambitieuze student op zoek naar een uitdagende stageplek waar je jouw kennis en vaardigheden verder kunt ontwikkelen? Abbott in Olst biedt interessante stageplekken voor die in 2027 gaan afstuderen en willen werken aan hun carrière binnen de farmaceutische industrie.

Wat ga je doen? 

Als stagiair bij Abbott ga je aan de slag op een van onze afdelingen, afhankelijk van jouw opleiding en interesses. Hier krijg je de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen en te leren van ervaren professionals binnen het vakgebied. Je zult betrokken worden bij verschillende projecten en werkzaamheden, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om jouw kennis toe te passen en nieuwe vaardigheden te ontwikkelen. Daarnaast krijg je de kans om zelfstandig te werken aan onderzoeksprojecten en rapportages te schrijven.

Wat bieden wij? 

Abbott biedt een dynamische en uitdagende werkomgeving waar je als stagiair volop kunt groeien en leren. Naast de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, krijg je bij ons de mogelijkheid om jouw theoretische kennis toe te passen en verder te ontwikkelen. Bovendien kom je terecht in een hecht team van professionals die jou graag willen ondersteunen en begeleiden tijdens jouw stage.

Wie zoeken wij? 

Wij zijn op zoek naar ambitieuze MBO, HBO en WO studenten die zichzelf verder willen ontwikkelen binnen de farmaceutische industrie. Je volgt een relevante opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van life sciences, farmacie, (bio)chemie, of technische bedrijfskunde, en hebt een grote interesse in dit vakgebied. Je bent leergierig, proactief en kunt goed samenwerken in een team.

Heb je interesse? 

Ben je geïnteresseerd in deze stageplek bij Abbott in Olst? Soliciteer direct en wie weet verwelkomen we jou binnenkort als stagiair binnen ons team! Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met recruitment.netherlands@abbott.com

Brand Building & Strategy

Digital Engagement

Digital Project Management

Effective Communication & Collaboration

Commercial Acumen

Must-Haves
• 5–8 years in content strategy/operations and digital media (brand or agency), with measurable results in engagement, acquisition, and conversion.

• Hands-on paid media experience (social, search, video/programmatic)—planning, trafficking, optimization, and reporting
• Strong analytics and financial acumen; ability to translate data into decisions and clear narratives for non-experts.

Nice-to-Haves

TOOLS & PLATFORMS

Integrate analytical and performance related elements with software, hardware, and electronics system components.

Experienced in SysML, Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodology, and system modeling tools. Experience in MBSE deployment a plus. Proficient in MagicDraw modeling software a plus. Certification in INCOSE ASEP/CSEP and/or SysML a plus.

The Opportunity 

This position works out of our Columbus, OH location in the Nutrition Division. In Research & Development, our ambition is to provide innovative high-quality products, creating sustainable value, delivering superior user experience, and enhancing health outcomes at all stages of life. 

Primary Job Function

The Microbiology Department within Abbott Nutrition’s R&D (Global Analytical and Food Safety) is responsible for conducting microbiological analysis of R&D project samples.

The Associate Scientist candidate is responsible for applying high quality laboratory techniques in the analysis of samples submitted for routine release testing of ingredients, in-process samples, finished products, and environmental monitoring samples. Additionally, support is provided to manufacturing sites for follow up studies, support of process system validation studies, and other requested special projects. 

The typical workload will include activities such as lab cleaning, preventive maintenance, media preparation, ordering supplies, pathogen screening tests, plate count tests, and genetic identifications.

This position will be accountable to the laboratory management and department management for outcomes related to assignments. The individual in this position is expected to organize time and means to accomplish the assigned tasks based on laboratory demands. 

What You’ll Work On

Implementing and maintaining the effectiveness of the quality system.

Conducting routine and complex microbiological procedures according to written and or verbal instruction with little direct supervision. Recognizes problems and errors and makes or seeks corrective actions.

Write technical reports.

Performing non-routine analysis when given direction.

Assisting in method validation and verification activities.

Reporting results according to documentation procedures and policies. 

Performing functions in compliance with relevant corporate and division procedures. 

Complying with laboratory safety practices.

Maintaining a clean, safe work environment.

Assist in training new microbiology lab personnel.

Act as liaison between lab and external parties.

Serving as a member of teams and committees as needed.

Required Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Microbiology or a life science discipline is required. Preference for Microbiology/Biology graduates.

The ideal candidate will have two to five years’ relevant work experience after completing a bachelor’s degree. Consideration may be given to less years of experience post-degree if experience is gained through internship or assignments in a related field.

Preferred:

At this level an individual will demonstrate a basic understanding of Microbiology and other scientific principles corresponding with an undergraduate degree level, gained through academic training or practical experience.

This position routinely communicates with laboratory co-workers and customers. 

Interpersonal relations skills are important. 

Problem solving skills are desirable for investigating or trouble shooting method related findings or any laboratory errors. 

 Ability to manage workload efficiently and with accuracy is critical.

Clear communication while working with co-workers, a high degree of motivation, and attention to detail is expected.

This is an on-site role - not a remote role.

Relocation assistance is not offered for this role.

This Staff Software Engineer, Mobile Applications position can work out remotely within the U.S.

Staff Software Engineer, Mobile Applications will work with a modern React Native and Golang-based tech stack on a mobile platform dedicated to improving the health and well-being of users in over 50 countries. The core mobile platform includes a system that interacts with a bio wearable sensor and is part of a large-scale environment responsible for processing billions of tasks daily. The candidate should possess strong leadership and technical skills and have a passion for software engineering to help guide the team's direction. Highly desirable qualities include versatility and a desire to continuously learn, improve, and empower team members. Lead the design and delivery of complex, high-performance mobile applications using React Native and embedded Go modules.

Define and drive mobile engineering best practices for both JS and Go layers.

Mentor and coach engineers, fostering technical growth and a culture of engineering excellence.

Partner with product, design, and architecture teams to align technical solutions with business goals.

Lead technical reviews, ensuring code quality, security, and adherence to architectural standards.

Identify and resolve systemic technical challenges, proactively addressing performance bottlenecks and scalability concerns in both React Native and Go code.

Contribute to the organization’s technical roadmap, influencing long-term technology choices and investment areas.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

8 years of professional software development experience, with 3+ years building and shipping complex mobile applications at scale.

Expert-level proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React Native.

Strong understanding of mobile architecture patterns, API design, performance optimization, and scalability.

Experience writing and maintaining either Swift, Kotlin, or C++

Proven ability to quickly learn and apply new programming languages, frameworks, and architectural patterns, maintaining effectiveness even when working outside of primary expertise.

Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience with event-driven architectures

Hands-on experience with Golang in a production environment or a strong desire to learn it.

Knowledge of mobile security best practices and secure coding standards.

Experience with mobile CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and app store deployment processes.

Demonstrated ability to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies to drive innovation.

Prior experience in the healthcare or other regulated industries

This role will serve as the technical clinical interface within R&D, owning product performance from a design perspective, and ensuring that field feedback is translated into compliant, risk‑based engineering solutions.

Experience with structural heart or transcatheter cardiovascular devices. 

Demonstrated experience working under Design Controls and ISO 13485 / FDA QSR environments. 

Experience owning or supporting IFUs, user needs, or human factors engineering for Class III medical devices.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct exposure to field action support, complaints investigations, or post‑market surveillance. 

Familiarity with human factors standards (IEC 62366), risk management (ISO 14971), and related FDA guidance. 

Experience supporting regulatory submissions related to design changes or field corrections. 

Experience working closely with clinicians, clinical engineers, or medical affairs teams.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

À propos d’Abbott

Abbott est un chef de file mondial de l’industrie des soins de santé qui crée des solutions scientifiques révolutionnaires visant à améliorer la santé des gens. L’entreprise est résolument tournée vers l’avenir, à l’affût des changements qui pourraient survenir dans le domaine des sciences et des technologies médicales.

Être à l’emploi d’Abbott 

En étant à l’emploi d’Abbott, vous pourrez faire un travail qui compte, vous perfectionner et apprendre, prendre soin de vous et des membres de votre famille, rester fidèle à ce que vous êtes et vivre pleinement. Vous pourrez :

profiter de possibilités d’avancement professionnel au sein d’une entreprise internationale qui vous permettra de bâtir la carrière dont vous rêvez;

travailler pour une entreprise reconnue dans des douzaines de pays partout dans le monde comme étant un excellent milieu de travail et figurant parmi les entreprises les plus admirées dans le monde dans le classement Fortune;

travailler pour une grande entreprise reconnue comme étant l’une des meilleures où travailler, notamment pour ce qui a trait à la diversité du personnel, à la conciliation travail-famille ainsi qu’à la place des femmes dans les postes de cadres et les postes scientifiques.

L’occasion à saisir

Ce poste est basé à notre siège social à Saint‑Laurent au sein de la division des produits nutritionnels et nécessite une présence au bureau quatre jours par semaine, avec la possibilité de travailler à distance une journée.

À titre de Représentant(e) sédentaire, vous serez responsable d’effectuer des appels téléphoniques de vente auprès des hôpitaux et des services de consultation externes situés en régions éloignées, afin de stimuler la demande pour les produits nutritionnels d’Abbott faisant l’objet d’un contrat. Les indicateurs de rendement clés sont établis annuellement.
 

Ce que vous ferez

Effectuer des appels téléphoniques auprès des hôpitaux de soins de courte durée et des services de consultation externes qui lui ont été assignés, pour les produits pour enfants et les produits pour adultes d’Abbott, afin de bien informer les professionnels de la santé au sujet des avantages de chaque produit, et ainsi d’accroître l’utilisation des produits, d’améliorer les résultats des patients et d’augmenter les parts de marché.

Contribuer à l’amélioration des pratiques cliniques et des protocoles d’alimentation, afin d’assurer la recommandation des produits nutritionnels d’Abbott sur la base de données probantes, d’exercer une influence sur les normes cliniques, d’assurer l’intégration des produits dans les parcours de soins et d’asseoir la crédibilité d’Abbott en tant que partenaire clinique de confiance.

S’assurer que les clients comprennent bien et respectent les ententes avec Abbott, notamment la structure de prix et les obligations contractuelles, afin de maintenir le respect des règles, d’éviter les écarts financiers, de prévenir les risques pour l’entreprise et de permettre aux clients de profiter de tous les avantages prévus au contrat.

Établir et maintenir des relations étroites avec les principaux partenaires (médecins, personnel infirmier, diététistes, gestionnaires des services alimentaires et agents ou agentes d’approvisionnement), afin d’accroître le sentiment de confiance, de donner lieu à des communications efficaces, d’accélérer la résolution de problèmes et de favoriser l’adoption des produits et la fidélité des clients.

Utiliser ses contacts, des données de recherche et des outils numériques pour atteindre les objectifs associés aux indicateurs de rendement clés, comme ceux relatifs aux ventes auprès des hôpitaux et ceux relatifs au nombre de visites quotidiennes, et ainsi générer des résultats stables dans le territoire, assurer une couverture efficace et permettre des décisions éclairées.

Consigner avec exactitude et en temps réel la distribution d’échantillons, les activités de vente et les interactions avec les clients à l’aide de Salesforce et de systèmes connexes, afin d’assurer le respect des règles et l’exactitude des prévisions, de se préparer à une éventuelle vérification et de déclarer l’information de façon transparente pour la planification commerciale.

Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des plans d’affaires pour le territoire, en analysant les indicateurs de rendement clés, en utilisant des tableaux de bord pour cerner les occasions à saisir et les lacunes, en déployant des efforts de façon stratégique, en maximisant la croissance du territoire et en veillant à ce que les mesures concordent avec les objectifs d’affaires nationaux.

Compétences requises 

Baccalauréat requis, préférable en nutrition – avoir travaillé comme diététiste constitue un atout majeur.

De 1 à 3 ans d’expérience clinique en milieu hospitalier constitue un atout.

L’expérience en vente constitue un atout.

Le ou la titulaire du poste doit pouvoir bien communiquer en anglais (50% du temps), car ses fonctions exigent des interactions avec des intervenants et collègues se trouvant à l’extérieur du Québec ou du Canada.

Compétences souhaitables

Compétences en gestion de temps et sens de l’organisation; capacité à effectuer de nombreuses tâches simultanément.

Aptitudes évidentes en communication, à l’oral et à l’écrit.

Capacité à s’adapter aux changements et à trouver des solutions de façon autonome.

Aptitudes pour les relations interpersonnelles permettant de tisser des liens avec des collègues.

The Opportunity 

This position is based at our St-Laurent office within the Nutrition division and requires on‑site presence four days per week, with the option to work remotely one day.

As the Inside Sales Representative, you’ll have the chance to conduct sales calls to remote hospitals and out-patient clinics generating demand for Abbott Nutrition’s contract items. KPIs are established on an annual basis.

What You’ll Do 

Conducts outbound calls to assigned acute-care hospitals and outpatient accounts for pediatric and adult portfolio products to ensure healthcare providers are well-informed about product benefits, driving increased usage, improved patient outcomes, and growth in market share.

Supports improvements in clinical practice and feeding protocols to drive evidence-based recommendations for nutrition products, influencing clinical standards, integrating products into patient care pathways, and strengthening Abbott’s credibility as a trusted clinical partner.

Ensures customers understand and adhere to vendor agreements, pricing structure and contract requirements to maintain compliance, prevent financial discrepancies, protect the company from risk, and ensure customers receive the full value of contracted benefits.

Builds and maintains strong relationships with key stakeholders (Physicians, Nurses, Registered Dietitians, Food Service Managers, Purchasing Agents) to increase trust, facilitate effective communication, accelerate issue resolution, and support continuous product adoption and loyalty.

Leverages relationships, research and digital tools to meet key performance indicators (KPIs), including hospital sales targets and daily call expectations, ensuring consistent territory performance, efficient coverage, and informed decision-making.

Documents accurately sampling, sales activities, and customer interactions in real-time using Salesforce and related systems to ensure compliance, support accurate forecasting, maintain audit readiness, and enable transparent reporting for business planning.

Develops and executes territory business plans by analyzing KPIs, using dashboards to identify opportunities and gaps, focusing efforts strategically, maximizing territory growth, and ensuring alignment with national business objectives.

Required Qualifications

Bacherlor’s degree in Nutrition, background as a registered dietician (RD) a significant asset.

1 to 3 years of clinical experience in a hospital is an asset.

Sales experience is an asset.

The incumbent must be able to communicate well in English (50% of the time), as his or her duties require interaction with stakeholders and colleagues outside Quebec and Canada.

Preferred Qualifications

Time management and organization skills required including multi-tasking.

Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to adapt and execute in a changing environment including solution finding independently.

Interpersonal skills building relationships with colleagues.

Bachelor’s degree in Bio-Medical Engineering, related field or equivalent healthcare experience. 

4+ years of related experience or a program certification from an accredited cardiac training program.

Familiarity with cath lab and operating room procedures and protocol

Demonstrate advanced knowledge of cardiac pacing systems.

Completion of day-to-day build activities within the R&D Sensor Line according to the daily build schedule.

Equipment and material ordering and maintenance with both internal and external functions.

Completion of batch records to a high-quality standard.

Providing support to the continuous development of new and complex Sensor products.

We’re looking for someone who is excited at the thought of joining a team at the forefront of Diabetes Care innovation and working in a fantastic modern and innovative environment.

Previous Laboratory or Manufacturing experience preferred but not essential.

A proactive and positive outlook.

Abbott – Heart Failure Division

Abbott’s Heart Failure business is expanding its Global Medical Affairs organization, and we are seeking an experienced Director, Global Medical Affairs to help shape the future of mechanical circulatory support and hemodynamic management worldwide.

This strategic leadership role reports directly to the Chief Medical Officer / Divisional Vice President, Global Medical Affairs and will be based in Europe.

Why This Role Matters

This is a high‑impact position at the forefront of advancing innovative therapies for patients living with heart failure. The Director will play a key role in guiding the clinical and scientific strategy across a rapidly evolving portfolio, partnering closely with Clinical Affairs, R&D, Market Access, Marketing, and Commercial teams.

The role requires a significant global presence (approx. 60% travel) to engage with investigators, clinical sites, and internal stakeholders.

This position will manage Clinical Research professionals to provide medical guidance for the business group, including support to maintain focus on product performance and safety, ISS, grants, and scientific activities. In addition, Director will work cross functionally to support the review, implementation and publication of clinical trial results. This role provides input to establish the range plans and goals for clinical science, and is responsible for the implementation and maintenance of the clinical research-related policies, processes and procedures related to their respective functional areas.

Director provides leadership and direction to product performance testing and evaluation, use clinical and medical experience and knowledge in the area of clinical research, and safety to direct risk management activities, and serves as an advisor to Clinical Affairs to support publications, abstracts and presentation of clinical research. Ensures critical input to establish and implement required product safety processes and procedures for new products and technologies as clinical studies are implemented, worldwide regulatory approvals are obtained and new products are commercialized.

Key responsibilities

Regionally responsible for Investigator Initiated Study and Research Grant programs

Develop the priorities for the Global Abbott HF ISS strategy

Responsible for medical affairs contributions to physician level professional education on advanced HF, MCS and hemodynamic management

Work with professional societies on increasing awareness and knowledge about advanced HF and hemodynamic management

Assists the commercial and marketing teams with strategic customer and KOL interactions as needed.

Leads and delivers internal educational activities related to HF

Provide input to R&D on all aspects and stages of the product portfolio

Support clinical affairs and help drive Abbott led trials and ensure the region is represented in critical evidence generation in the field of HF.

Be responsible for off label discussions with clinicians in the OUS region.

Assist market access with clinical input to reimbursement processes OUS

Represent Abbott HF Medical Affairs in interactions with regulatory bodies

Assists investigation teams by providing medical input as needed.

Provides medical support for reporting to regulatory authorities when needed.

Responsible for updating medical affairs procedural documents and submitting change requests when needed.

Key Requirements

MD degree (+ 8 years) with clinical experience in the cardiovascular disease area

Applicants with documented medical or surgical experience treating patients with advanced heart failure will be preferred

Experience with medical research and scientific publishing required.

Industry experience preferred but not required.

Fluent English required, any additional language is a plus

We are committed to building a foundation for our people to be successful, investing in their development and growth, and creating a diverse, inclusive culture that welcomes different perspectives, experiences and backgrounds.

You will identify and routinely use the most effective, cost-efficient, and best business practices to execute processes, regularly communicating insights, feedback, and results to managers and team. Additional responsibilities include: 

Gaining foundational knowledge of EP through a structured training program with a strong emphasis on hands-on learning and practical application. 

Providing regional EP procedural case coverage in an Electrophysiology lab and/or operating room setting. 

Acting as a clinical interface between the medical community and the business. 

Demonstrating the ability to build and sustain credible clinical relationships with customers and sharing product expertise accordingly. 

Demonstrating a thorough command of all EP products, including technical details, software utilization, and capabilities. 

Providing engineering, sales, education, and clinical support on the safe and effective use of Abbott EP products, including cardiac mapping, diagnostic, and therapy systems. 

Supporting EP Sales Representatives in the following areas: 

Collaborating with sales personnel; 

Facilitating regional training seminars; 

Participating in clinical studies/data collection; 

Troubleshooting; and,

Continuously develops engineering, sales and technical skills aligned with the overall territory strategy, including learning from senior sales personnel and management. 

Staying up-to-date on the latest industry developments, regulatory requirements, and maintains strong knowledge of company and competitor products, market trends, and strategic goals. 

Providing management with feedback on market trends and customer insights to inform strategic decisions and guide next-generation product development. 

Participating in occasional travel for in-person instruction and live procedure coverage.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Abbott’s Nutrition Division develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow, to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands – including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure® and Glucerna® – to help get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest life.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The Maintenance Front Line Leader is a working supervisor who leads a small team of maintenance technicians and supports the ongoing production operation of an aseptic liquid nutritional manufacturing facility.

Maintenance:

Assist in development, planning, and execution of all plant-related maintenance activities including Preventative, Predictive, and Demand maintenance work.

Develop and refine detailed maintenance job plans and procedures.

Provide training, guidance, and mentorship to plant maintenance staff members.

Trouble-shoot and resolve equipment-related issues that impact ongoing production.

Work with the Operations, Engineering, and Quality teams to investigate, identify root cause, and implement corrective actions for equipment-related failures.

Able to work off shifts.

EHS: 

Model and promote the behaviors that support a continuously improving EHS culture by engaging with employees and other key stakeholders in ensuring all EHS requirements are met inclusive of internal and external regulatory objectives and direction. Coach and direct individuals in delivering EHS performance for themselves, their team and department.

Preparation and active participation in internal and external EHS audits and incident/accident investigation and reporting; coupled with timely implementation of corrective and preventative actions.

Quality: 

Model and promote the behaviors that ensure delivery of high quality products for our customers while maintaining compliance with Abbott policies and procedures, meeting all local and statutory requirements, and adhering to the regulatory requirements of countries to which products are shipped. Lead efforts required delivering quality and compliance performance for the shift/ line of accountability Initiate, manage, and make decisions which impact product quality.

Preparation and active participation in internal and external Quality audits and incident investigation and reporting; coupled with timely implementation of corrective and preventative action.

Finance / Business Acumen: 

Model and promote a thorough understanding of what drives product costs, profitability and cash flow for the shift and within the department, while operating within budget material utilization and Cost Improvement Program goals. Manage budget accountability for Headcount, Overtime, and direct expenses for a shift and/or line. Track, trend and continuously improve budgetary performance for direct expenses, headcount, overtime (OT), Operating Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), production (Unit/Hour, Pounds/Hour), Material Usage Variance (MUV) and Scrap and Cost Improvement Projects (CIP).

Understand financial statements, key performance measures, and provide input for all line budgetary decisions. Develop the skills necessary to manage financial budgetary line items involving headcount management, overtime, scrap reduction and material utilization variance (MUV). Share in the preparation of the annual budget and any updating reviews.

Direct Financial accountability up to $ 2MM USD.

Productivity:

Promote and drive continuous improvement programs utilizing common problem solving tools and methodologies in processes and procedures within the shift/ operating line/ department for root cause analysis and resolution of issues. 

Actively plan and organize the day to day manufacturing operations and schedules.

Anticipate and drive proper alignment and prioritization between production and support teams.

Drive OEE performance, understand the drivers, and develop and execute plans around improvement of line performance and quality metrics with support from the direct manager. Understand all key performance indicators, driving and executing plans for improvement through team engagement.

People:

Model and promote organizational values by providing effective leadership, direction, development and support to the team. Drive a culture of engagement through the High Performance Work Team. Directly supervises team and participates in performing repairs and staffing activities.

Assure team members are trained and understand duties, responsibilities, and performance against established expectations.

Provide timely coaching, counseling and feedback. 

Develop all line personnel by securing appropriate training, providing mentoring and assigning progressively challenging stretch responsibilities within the scope of the team and department accountabilities.

Engage in drafting own goals, lead the process of development of team goals and growth planning. Create a learning environment and support individuals learning and development plans.

Ensure delivery of effective performance management while establishing and sustaining a positive work environment.

Execution of on time performance reviews for direct reports

Establish a communications framework that assures timely and relevant transfer of information to and from all levels and functional areas of the organization.

Ensure compliance with all HR practices, policies and procedures.

Understand and effectively use the rewards and recognition programs. 

Champion positive employee relations by maintaining a high profile presence on the floor, direct engagement with employees, regular open communications and encouraging knowledge sharing and open exchange of ideas.

Scope & Accountability:

This position will require some general direction and supervision from direct manager; with key decisions being made in collaboration with direct manager and High Performance Work Team. The Maintenance Front Line Leader will initially be learning through the direct coaching of management the leadership requirements to become competent in delivering organizational results in all key performance areas. He/She will develop the competence to lead their shift team in consistently meeting all organizational expectations of a Front Line shift team. Works with their direct manager to identify change opportunities and effectively manage these to positive outcomes for individuals, team, line and the business.

Conduct preventative maintenance programs, inspects, lubricates, repairs, and overhauls a wide variety of mechanical, plumbing and electrical, but not limited to: fire protection systems, building HVAC, egress systems and exit lighting. Analyze equipment breakdowns to determine source of trouble or malfunction. Recommend and or perform repairs to equipment.

Leadership in this role will primarily be focused on the direct reporting group with support from the direct manager, as required. Focus is on day to day operations, with short term focus based on meeting requirements that are tactical versus strategic. 

Manage and guide the TPM team(s) to improve quality and increase productivity on the line. Communicates to line the High Performance Work Team daily while maintaining a constant floor presence. Maintains a safe work environment with 100% training and compliance to applicable procedures.

Coordinates activities related to shift starts and changes. Leads and coordinates daily activities of the shift team to meet daily requirements that positively impact the rest of the multi-shift line results. Working with their direct manager, other Front Line Leaders and other management, will establish the High Performance Work Team culture where people feel empowered, are accountable for the business and continuously improving the shift and the line. Communicates with other departments and functions as needed in support of meeting operational objectives.

Interprets and executes policies that affect work processes and personnel within the assigned organizational unit.

Manages personnel and processes to ensure production meets all associated quality standards.

Financial management for assigned Maintenance by managing headcount utilization, reducing line downtime and scrap. This list is not all inclusive.

Promote team, department and site goals through team communications and providing direction and guidance towards achievement.

Active participation in team and department projects including responsibility for execution of assigned actions. 

Track, trend & report on established KPI's; communicating to functional manager and site leadership team on accomplishments, opportunities for improvement and planned actions.

Follows escalation reporting process with inputs from peers/manager for decision making as required. Make and communicate decisions that are appropriate for level of accountability.

Budgetary accountability is limited – $2MM USD

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE YOU’LL BRING

High School Diploma or GED

Possesses a working technical knowledge and application of concepts, practices, and procedures within engineering discipline.

Bachelors degree in technical discipline preferred.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Job Title 

Director Site Quality Assurance 

The Opportunity 

Abbott Nutrition is seeking a dynamic QA leader for the role of Director, Site Quality Assurance for an international expat assignment at our New Zealand site. This 2-3 year relocation opportunity will play a critical role in driving quality excellence and ensuring the successful integration of Synlait into Abbott’s global operations. 

The Director of Quality Assurance (QA) is responsible for leading and coordinating all Quality Assurance activities at the Abbott Nutrition New Zealand site. This role ensures the implementation and continuous improvement of comprehensive QA systems, processes, and programs aligned with the company’s quality standards to consistently deliver high-quality products and exceed customer expectations. 

The Director will define and execute strategies that optimize compliance, enhance organizational efficiency, and manage costs through the adoption of new technologies, evaluation of current practices, knowledge sharing, and the application of Business Excellence tools. In partnership with the Site Director, this position holds accountability for plant compliance and serves as a key advisor to Division leadership on critical matters, including product quality, safety, and regulatory issues. 

Additionally, the Director plays a pivotal role in supporting the timely and compliant introduction of new products to market. This position requires close collaboration and strategic alignment with site leadership teams and peers across Global Manufacturing, Materials Management, Engineering, R&D, Commercial Operations, Regulatory Affairs, and Legal. The role also involves direct engagement with external business partners and regulatory authorities to uphold quality and compliance standards. 

What You’ll Work On 

Integration Leadership: Manage the end-to-end integration of Synlait, ensuring operational, cultural, and strategic alignment. 

Directs the Plant Quality Assurance Operations Organization to ensure positive compliance outcomes at the site. 

Develops the site quality strategy to achieve business objectives at the plant level while ensuring operations is in compliance with global regulatory requirements, making key decisions on product quality and regulatory conformance issues. 

Directs and implements programs at the site to comply with all regulatory requirements to ensure products and services meet customer expectations. 

Supports the resolution of product quality issue resolutions with Division Quality Assurance, Medical, Regulatory Affairs, Legal, Operations, Materials Management, Purchasing and Engineering. 

Assure line of communication with Senior Leaders on critical quality issues that may result in potential business interruption. 

Provide oversight to disposition of high risk product non-conformance situations, assure adequate investigation and corrective actions are in place to prevent future occurrences. - 

Assure staffing and leadership continuity through talent management succession planning and developmental moves. Create a diverse organization and encourage diversity within the organization. 

In conjunction with Division Quality, monitor consumer complaint trends, identify, communicate and address adverse trends that may impact future business. 

Ensure corrective and preventative actions are taken to prevent recurrence. - Assure successful launch of new and revised products by incorporating the appropriate quality assurance programs/systems into plant operations. - 

Directly responsible with interface with outside regulators ( FDA, Ministries of Health, Notified Bodies) and other government regulatory bodies. Responsible for site compliance and is the primary interface during audits and interactions with regulators. 

This position is accountable to the DVP QA, Site Operations head and divisional and Corporate Quality for achieving mutually agreed objectives on a timely basis. 

Decisions and recommendations made by this position have a direct impact on products for domestic and international sales. 

Must effectively communicate, prepare, and negotiate both internally with site and divisional personnel and externally with various regulatory agencies. 

Position impacts operations through GMP compliance requirements and activities such as audits, training, etc. 

Failure to maintain a Quality System compliance to the QSR can lead to warning letter or more severe regulatory actions resulting in multi-year impact. 

Control budget and quality costs. Authorize cost efficiency projects that maintain compliance and alignment with QS requirements while contributing to Division margin improvement initiatives. - 

Required Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administrations, Life Science, Engineering, Industrial Technology or related field. 

7+ years in Quality or compliance discipline in an FDA regulated Industry 

7+ years Supervisory/Management experience

The Corporate Engineering (CE) organization is looking for an experienced and motivated individual to serve as Fire Protection Program Manager. This opportunity is for someone who wants to positively impact the organization in a meaningful role that applies advanced engineering knowledge and experience, combined with a disciplined project management approach, to deliver business solutions that span across divisions and regions. A part of Global Engineering Services (GES), Corporate Engineering exists to support Abbott’s businesses and help them drive sustainable growth and margin improvement. Corporate Engineering does this by planning, designing and deploying Facilities, Utilities & Infrastructure projects with excellence, by means of strong talent, best practices, resourcefulness, and experience. The GES/CE Fire Protection Program Manager role significantly contributes to that mission by leading and executing engineering activities across a broad set of responsibilities as outlined below.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Fire Protection Program Manager is an engineering professional who, working with little or no supervision, applies advanced scientific and engineering knowledge, mathematics and ingenuity to complete complex assignments related to the Fire Protection Engineering discipline. A Fire Protection Program Manager has full knowledge of other related disciplines beyond their own.

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Technical / Design: Benchmarks internally and externally. Independently executes or directs others in the design of facilities/utilities/infrastructure systems, by applying novel and proven engineering concepts and techniques. Performs detailed analysis, communicates across functions and disciplines, and serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in design reviews.

Project Management: Identifies, plans and executes projects of varying degrees of complexity within engineering specialty, requiring custom risk-managed execution plans. Works with the client and cross-functional stakeholders to establish scope, cost and schedule on multiple projects. Independently performs economic analysis and feasibility studies related to complex and often multiple competing project alternatives. Manages multiple projects, often concurrently, maintaining project controls and reporting for scope, cost and schedule. Responsible for achieving the projects’ financial targets in support of business objectives.

Problem Solving / Innovation: Creates or coordinates design solutions for novel or complex problems focusing on cost-benefit, integrating regulatory needs (e.g. NFPA, Fire Code, Building Code, and Factory Mutual (FM) requirements) and operational needs (e.g. processes, materials, and people requirements). Structures studies to address cross-disciplinary and cross-functional issues and arrive at optimal solutions.

Organizational Interface: Mentors others by sharing technical knowledge and providing guidance. Where appropriate, provides tasks and project assignment opportunities for employee development and evaluates performance. Represents the organization as the prime technical contact, interacting with senior management and external parties on complex technical matters often requiring coordination between organizations. Conveys information effectively through formal and informal means including proposals, reports, design documentation, and presents to senior executive leadership. Submits articles for internal or external publication.

Compliance: Responsible for compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional policies, procedures, and standards for Quality, Environmental, Health, Safety and Energy (EHS&E), Abbott Engineering Standards (AES), and other governance areas as applicable.

Additional Responsibilities May Include: Responsible for all matters pertaining the Fire Protection Engineering discipline as the global SME. Participates in internal cross-divisional teams to develop new, or revise existing, procedures and standards, and provides training. Directs the efforts of others such as engineers, technicians and outside resources. Crafts and submits Requests for Capital Expenditures (RCEs), safety/quality checklists, executive presentations, and projects financial reports. Resolves problems and crisis situations requiring assertive decisions and hands-on rapid implementation, by leveraging technical training and experience. Represents engineering on corporate and division initiatives.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE / SKILLS

B.S. degree in Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline is required.

M.S. degree in Fire Protection Engineering is required if B.S. degree is not in Fire Protection Engineering.

Professional Engineer (PE) license is a plus.

Certifications: Certified Fire Protection Specialist (CFPS) is required.

Professional Affiliations: SFPE or NFPA membership is a plus.

Minimum of 12 years of experience in the design and deployment of fire protection solutions across building facilities and utilities systems.

Mastery of applicable codes, including NFPA (National Fire Protection Association), NEC (National Electrical Code), IFC (International Fire Code), IBC (International Building Code), and other local, national, and international regulatory requirements.

Experience with Fire Prevention/Detection/Suppression, Risk Management, and Loss Prevention.

Experience with fire protection systems including gas, water, pre-action, foam, and clean agent.

Experience with seismic bracing of fire protection systems.

Experience with underground fire mains, lead-ins, piping, and thrust blocks.

Experience with flammable liquids and hazardous materials storage, and maximum allowable quantities.

Experience with warehouses including flue spacing, high density storage, in-rack sprinklers, and commodity classifications.

Experience with Performance-Based Design (PBD) approach.

Experience with Life Safety and Egress analysis.

Experience with fire alarm, smoke detection, and smoke control systems.

Experience with Factory Mutual (FM) requirements, Plan Reviews, and inspection reports/responses.

Experience assessing the design and performance of fire protection and life safety systems on existing facilities, identifying gaps versus regulatory requirements and AES, and developing remediation plans.

Experience supporting construction and commissioning testing of fire protection and life safety systems.

Experience with fire/explosion protection on manufacturing processes is desired but not required.

Experience in regulated industries (e.g. medical device, pharmaceutical, or nutritional)

Excellent leadership, problem-solving, interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Proficiency in MS Project/Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Outlook, AutoCAD, SAP, Smartsheet, and Bluebeam.

Proven track record of successful execution throughout the entire project lifecycle: Feasibility –> Concept –> Design –> Construction –> Commissioning & Qualification –> Turnover –> Closeout.

When you join Abbott EP, you become part of a passionate group of individuals who are dedicated to driving the EP space forward and helping people live longer, fuller lives. We are committed to building a foundation for our people to be successful, investing in their development and growth, and creating a diverse, inclusive culture that welcomes different perspectives, experiences and backgrounds. 

What You’ll Work On

Working under general direction, provides engineering, sales, educational and technical support in response to field inquiries from physicians, health care professionals, patients, and field sales staff, involving EP products. Identifies and routinely uses the most effective, cost efficient and best business practices to execute processes; continually evaluates their effectiveness and appropriateness. Exercises independent judgment in planning, organizing and performing work; monitors performance and reports status to manager.

You will join a high-functioning, collaborative team, partnering closely with physicians and hospital staff to support the diagnosis and treatment of abnormal heart rhythms to achieve better patient outcomes. In this role, individuals will exercise independent judgment in planning, organizing, and performing day-to-day tasks. You will identify and routinely use the most effective, cost-efficient, and best business practices to execute processes, regularly communicating insights, feedback, and results to managers and team. Additional responsibilities include: 

Gaining foundational knowledge of EP through a structured training program with a strong emphasis on hands-on learning and practical application. 

Providing regional EP procedural case coverage in an Electrophysiology lab and/or operating room setting. 

Acting as a clinical interface between the medical community and the business. 

Demonstrating the ability to build and sustain credible clinical relationships with customers and sharing product expertise accordingly. 

Demonstrating a thorough command of all EP products, including technical details, software utilization, and capabilities. 

Providing engineering, sales, education, and clinical support on the safe and effective use of Abbott EP products, including cardiac mapping, diagnostic, and therapy systems. 

Supporting EP Sales Representatives in the following areas: 

Collaborating with sales personnel; 

Facilitating regional training seminars; 

Participating in clinical studies/data collection; 

Troubleshooting; and, 

Leading/supporting new product in-service trainings and/or demonstrations to physicians, nurses, and sales representatives. 

Continuously develops engineering, sales and technical skills aligned with the overall territory strategy, including learning from senior sales personnel and management. 

Staying up-to-date on the latest industry developments, regulatory requirements, and maintains strong knowledge of company and competitor products, market trends, and strategic goals. 

Providing management with feedback on market trends and customer insights to inform strategic decisions and guide next-generation product development. 

Participating in occasional travel for in-person instruction and live procedure coverage.

EDTS – en del av Abbott

European Drug Testing Service (EDTS) AB startade sin verksamhet 1991 inom området slumpvisa drogtester på arbetsplatsen. Idag ingår EDTS i Abbott koncernen och vi är med våra fyra affärsområden ett ledande drogtestföretag i Norden. Förutom genomförande av drogtester på arbetsplatser, bistår vi vårdföretag med administrativa tjänster och digitala lösningar inom drogtestning och laboratorieanalyser.

Vi säljer och förmedlar även högkvalitativa produkter för drogtestning, bl.a. screeningstester (POCT) i saliv och urin, instrument för drogtestning, alkometrar samt reagenser.

Våra kunder finns bl.a. inom kommun och landsting, arbetsgivare och företagshälsovård, laboratorier, privata vårdgivare samt skolor. Vår företagskultur präglas av kvalitet, trygghet och innovation samt en fortsatt ambition att i nära samarbete med våra samarbetspartners och kunder driva utvecklingen i branschen.

EDTS växer och med ökat kundantal samt med utveckling av vårt tjänsteutbud behöver vi vara fler provtagare som fortsätter ge våra kunder bästa tänkbara service.

Just nu söker vi Provtagare i Stockholm med omnejd, med start under våren!

Som provtagare hos EDTS arbetar du självständigt med att utföra slumpvisa alkohol- och drogtester hos våra kunder som är arbetsgivare. Arbetet som provtagare ska ses som ett komplement till ditt ordinarie arbete. I rollen ingår att du skall kunna arbeta på oregelbundna arbetstider även kvällar, nätter samt helger. I rollen som provtagare utgår du från ditt hem och du har stor möjlighet att själv planera dina pass under en månad.

Som provtagare har du ett stort personligt ansvar och har nära samarbete med dina kollegor på huvudkontoret i Kista.

ANSVAR:

Du ansvarar för att självständigt boka in dina uppdrag hos vår kunder i enlighet med gällande rutiner

Genomföra alkohol- och drogtest (via saliv eller urin) i enlighet med Chain of Custody

Genomföra utbildningar som är tilldelade dig och närvara på obligatoriska möten via Teams

Hålla utbildningar för nya provtagare vid behov

KVALIFIKATIONER OCH UTBILDNING:

Minimum undersköterska eller BMA

Du måste ha körkort och egen bil

Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift

Du bor i Stockholms län eller i närheten.

FÖREDRAGNA KVALIFIKATIONER

Erfarenhet av företagshälsovård och/eller laboratorietjänster

Erfarenhet av att utbilda andra

KOMPETENS:

Utmärkt kommunikativ förmåga

Strukturerad och noggrann

Hög ansvarskänsla och serviceinriktad inställning

Måste visa starkt eget driv

Du ska kunna arbeta självständigt

God systemvana

I ditt personliga brev önskar vi även att du har besvarat nedanstående frågor då detta är ett extra arbete till ditt ordinarie arbete.

Konzeption, Kodierung und Implementierung von Tools, Skripten, Makros und Anwendungen zur Prozessautomatisierung.

Weiterentwicklung und Standardisierung von Supply-Chain-Planungssystemen und Reporting-Tools.

Bewertung neuer Technologien und Systemlösungen und Entwicklung entsprechender Rollout-Strategien.

Aufbau, Pflege und Optimierung komplexer Datenbanken zur Verbesserung von Datenqualität, -verfügbarkeit und -transparenz.

Nutzung moderner Programmier- und Datenmanagementmethoden zur Unterstützung täglicher und strategischer Aktivitäten (z. B. Datenmodellierung, Prozessautomatisierung, Performance-Analysen).

2. Integration globaler Supply-Chain-Informationssysteme

Entwicklung und Umsetzung global einheitlicher Daten- und Systemarchitekturen.

Reduktion redundanter Datenquellen und Steigerung der datenseitigen Konsistenz und Nutzbarkeit über alle Geschäftsbereiche hinweg.

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit IT, globalen Produktionsstandorten und Commercial-Organisationen.

Sicherstellung der datentechnischen und analytischen Grundlage für die Abstimmung zwischen Operations, Commercial und Finance.

Konsolidierung, Qualitätsprüfung und Validierung globaler Daten aus allen Funktionen.

Erstellung analytisch fundierter IBP-Präsentationen sowie RU/RD-Dateien.

Sammlung, Aufbereitung und Integration von Verkaufsprognosen für neue oder umgestellte Produkte.

Kommentierung von Abweichungen und Ableitung von datenbasierten Handlungsempfehlungen.

4. KPI-Entwicklung, -Analyse und -Management

Aufbau und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung eines konsistenten KPI-Frameworks für die gesamte Division.

Sicherstellung einheitlicher Messmethoden und Datenstandards an allen Produktionsstandorten.

Monatliche Analyse und Berichterstattung von Leistungskennzahlen, inkl. Ursachenanalysen.

Entwicklung datenbasierter Maßnahmenpläne zur Leistungssteigerung.

Bedarfs- und Lieferplanung für interne Produktionsstandorte sowie TPM-Reagenzien, Zubehör und Ersatzteile für EDC.

Nutzung analytischer Methoden und Planungssysteme zur Sicherstellung optimaler Versorgungssicherheit.
