Job Title: Principal Value Consultant

Job Summary

We are seeking a strategic Value Consultant dedicated to advancing the development of our Value Consulting organization at Adobe. This role emphasizes building compelling arguments to demonstrate the value of Adobe Firefly Services and solutions to prospective clients while driving sales and customer adoption. The ideal candidate will possess a solid grasp of software sales processes, value-based selling, and have experience translating technical features into business benefits. They will also have a solid understanding of go-to-market and business skills to help customers understand how to use Adobe software to drive business outcomes and present to influencers as well as executive decision makers.

Key Responsibilities

Develop Business Cases: Work with sales teams, including Account Executives, Solution Consultants, and Solution Architects. Build detailed arguments to demonstrate the return on investment and value of our software solutions. 

Design Value Frameworks: Refine frameworks for value consulting that can be consistently applied across different products and client scenarios.

Client Engagement: Work directly with clients to understand their needs and challenges, in order to articulate how Adobe solutions can create measurable value for their business.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product management, marketing, and leadership to ensure alignment on value messaging and capability. Gather insights that inform argument development.

Training and Enablement: Create and deliver training sessions for sales teams to enhance their understanding of Value Consulting methodologies and to equip them with tools for effective client engagement.

Metrics and Reporting: Help develop and support objective and key results to measure the effectiveness of value consulting initiatives and provide data for regular reports to senior management on progress and outcomes.

Market Research: Stay updated on industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs to continuously refine value propositions and argument strategies.

What you need to succeed:

Masters in Business Administration (MBA), Marketing, or a related experience.

5+ years of experience in a consulting, sales, or product management role within the software industry.

Strong understanding of case development and value-based selling principles.

Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information in a clear and compelling manner.

Proven track record of collaborating with cross-functional teams and getting results in a fast-paced environment.

Analytical approach with the ability to interpret data and insights to inform strategic decisions.

Familiarity with financial modeling and analysis.

Experience in customer engagement and relationship management.

Knowledge of software solutions and technology trends relevant to our industry.

Join our team at Adobe, where creativity and innovation blend with collaboration, and legal minds lead the way in shaping the future. Seeking an Associate Legal Counsel who is sharp, savvy, and prepared to excel in our dynamic team.

We are looking for a recently qualified or early-career lawyer (0–2 years PQE) admitted to the Bar Association, eager to build their in-house career and make a meaningful contribution to our operations within the Central (Eastern Europe) and Iberia (Spain and Portugal) regions. You will be supported and mentored by the Managing Counsel and the wider legal team as you develop your in-house expertise.

Why Join Us?

A Legal Team Like No Other: Supportive, encouraging, and—above all—friendly. We lift each other up, share knowledge freely, and always find time to celebrate wins (big or small).

Diversity & Inclusion: We champion every voice, celebrate every background, and believe that brilliant ideas come from everywhere.

Work/Life Balance: We know life is more than work. Flexible schedules and hybrid options are here to keep you energized.

Competitive Salary & Benefits: A comprehensive compensation package intended to support and reward employees.

Growth & Opportunity: Adobe is rapidly growing, and so can you. Structured mentoring and a clear development path are built into this role. Get involved in crafting new systems (think: AI chatbots, CLM, knowledge sharing, automation) and work processes.

The challenge 

Build your in-house legal career by supporting our dynamic sales team and working alongside colleagues in marketing, finance, procurement, and beyond. Under the guidance of our Managing Counsel, you will develop into a trusted legal partner for the Central and Iberia Regions.

What You’ll Do

Draft, Review & Negotiate: Work and negotiate on a variety of agreements—license, professional services, consulting, statements of work, resale, distribution, sales, and licensing. You’ll keep us covered and keep deals moving.

Commercial Legal Support: Partner with our business units, providing timely, commercial advice and delivering in-house training on the legal topics that matter most. Help demystify law for your colleagues!

Compliance Monitor: Monitor and flag relevant regulatory and legal developments — particularly in technology, AI, intellectual property, and data privacy — and support senior counsel in analysing their impact on Adobe.

Drive Process Improvement: Dive into knowledge management and help evolve our legal processes. Lead departmental projects that make us better, smarter, and faster.

Embrace Legal Technology: Use AI-assisted tools for contract analysis, research, and document drafting as part of your day-to-day workflow. Develop hands-on fluency in the technologies that are reshaping how legal services are delivered — no prior experience required, just a genuine curiosity about what’s coming next.

Project Legal Support: Join working groups as new projects and business practices are developed, bringing your legal and business perspective where it’s needed most.

Ongoing Training & Risk Management: Carry out internal training sessions, and offer continuous support on key risks—building a culture of compliance and confidence.

What you need to succeed

Qualified Lawyer: Admitted to the Bar Association with 0–2 years PQE. In-house or law firm experience is welcome; we are equally open to recently qualified candidates who are the right fit.

Commercial/IT/IP Interest: You have foundational knowledge or a strong interest in commercial, technology, or IP law — gained through studies, internships, or early practice. You have an appetite to deepen your understanding of the complexities of software, technology, and data protection in a fast-moving tech company.

Business and Risk Savvy: You see the bigger picture and understand how legal matters fit into business objectives, assess, and manage risks across multiple matters at once.

Communication Skills: You have strong drafting ability and good attention to detail, and you can translate complex legalese into everyday plain language.

Languages: Proficient in English and Romanian (required). Spanish or Portuguese is a genuine advantage given the Iberia scope of the role.

Flexible & Adaptable: You’re quick on your feet, ready to adjust when the business demands change.

What Makes This Role Fun & Cool?

Build the Future: Play a key role in Adobe’s evolution, especially in this fast-paced tech and AI culture.

Tech Meets Law: Dive into brand new systems and technology incorporating AI, CLM, and automation—assist us in scaling smarter!

Room to Grow: Take on new challenges, lead projects, collaborate with a distributed team, and develop your own expertise as Adobe expands.

Fun Perks: Celebrations, creativity challenges, and team-building events—plus some of the best colleagues in the business.

Experience contributing to full-stack delivery in production, ideally with data-heavy or analytics applications (e.g., dashboards, important metrics, observability tools). Background in frontend data visualization, backend optimization, or AI-assisted workflows.

Previous mentoring or informal leadership in scaling features or small projects.

Hands-on technical involvement while developing people-leadership skills.

Competitive salary and benefits packages.

Job Description- Enterprise Architect

Position Summary

As an Adobe Enterprise Architect, you will define and deliver enterprise scale digital

experience architectures that leverage Adobe Experience Cloud, AI/ML capabilities, and

modern cloud platforms. You will partner with senior business and technology leaders to

shape strategy, architecture roadmaps, and operating models that drive measurable customer

and business outcomes.

You will combine deep enterprise architecture expertise with AI, data, and cloud-native

experience to design future-ready solutions: from customer data foundations and decisioning

to personalized, omnichannel experiences. As a trusted advisor, you will guide clients through

digital, data, and AI transformation, ensuring alignment between business goals, technology

investments, and delivery teams.

Success in this role is measured by customer value and adoption, quality and feasibility of

architectures, clarity of roadmaps, impact on KPIs, and depth of trusted relationships rather

than billable hours alone.

The Opportunity

Digital is disrupting traditional business models and reshaping every stage of the customer

lifecycle. Leading organizations are turning to Adobe Experience Cloud and AI-powered

experiences to stay ahead.

Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture team is a dynamic group of senior consultants who:

• Partner with executives to define digital, data, and AI strategies.

• Design integrated architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation.

• Help clients adopt cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven patterns on platforms such

as Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Cloud solutions, and public cloud

providers.

As an Enterprise Architect, you will use your knowledge of digital marketing technology,

AI/ML capabilities, and enterprise architecture to:

• Create strategic roadmaps for digital experience and AI innovation.

• Lead clients as a subject matter expert.

• Serve as a trusted advisor across business, data, and technology stakeholders.

What you'll Do

• Shape digital, data, and AI strategy

o Partner with executive and senior client stakeholders to define digital experience,

customer data, and AI/ML goals.

o Translate business vision into actionable multi-year architecture roadmaps

encompassing Adobe solutions, data/ML platforms, and cloud services.

o Identify key business drivers, KPIs, and value hypotheses to prioritize use cases

(e.g., personalization, journey orchestration, next-best action, marketing

optimization).

• Design enterprise and solution architectures

o Design end-to-end architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client

ecosystems.

o Define AI- and data-centric architectures, including: Customer data platforms,

identity, and profile management.

o Data ingestion, quality, governance, and activation patterns. Recommend futurestate

technology architectures using cloud-native principles (API-first,

microservices, event-driven, serverless) across Azure, AWS, and/or other public

clouds.

o Define reference architectures and patterns for secure, scalable cloud

deployments. Zero-trust, identity, and access management. Observability and

reliability.

• Drive alignment and governance

o Ensure alignment between business strategies, enterprise architecture, and

delivery teams across marketing, product, data, and IT.

o Define governance, operating models, and ways of working (e.g., architecture

review processes, decision forums, standards) to support sustainable adoption of

Adobe capabilities.

o Act as a liaison between Adobe teams, client business owners, IT, data/analytics,

and external partners for the full lifecycle of the engagement.

• Communicate and evangelize

o Communicate architecture options, trade-offs, and recommendations to C-level

and senior leadership using clear narratives, visuals, and value framing.

o Lead workshops, visioning sessions, and roadmap presentations that evangelize

AI and data driven digital experiences.

o Advocate for the Enterprise Architecture function and your work within the larger

Adobe Consulting organization and with clients.

• Contribute to practice growth

o Capture and codify reusable assets (reference architectures, patterns, templates,

accelerators).

o Mentor other architects and consultants on enterprise, AI, and cloud architecture

best practices.

o Support pre-sales activities (e.g., solutioning, estimations, proposals, executive

presentations) to position Adobe and EA services.

o

What you need to succeed

• proven record to develop enterprise architecture models.

• Validated experience with architecture frameworks such as API, SOA, and TOGAF

• Understanding & experience with public cloud architecture and services (Microsoft

Azure / Amazon AWS).

• Experience designing or integrating AI-powered customer experiences, including

working with LLM-based services and understanding core concepts such as prompt

design, RAG, and model evaluation strategies.

• Ability to collaborate with data/ML teams to define AI solution patterns and

guardrails, including basic awareness of agentic workflows and tool using agents, and

how they impact reliability, observability, and governance in enterprise environments.

• Experience from working with the Adobe Experience Cloud or at least one of its

solutions & Previous experience with other Digital Marketing platforms. (Good to

have).

• Experience communicating across senior leadership.

• Ability to intake client business vision and translate to technical solution and

architecture requirements.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills communicating deliverables, sharing

information, and leading meetings.

• Ability to communicate and lead execution of architecture vision across multifunctional

technical and strategy teams.

• Experience working with software engineers, data architects, application developers &

data scientists to plan out end-to-end solutions

• Understanding the solutions and systems that support it.

• Ability to communicate technical and business strategy optimally to audiences of

varying levels of experience, background, and seniority.

• Ability to travel a minimum of up to 50%.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized

throughout the world on Best Companies lists. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who

are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where

ongoing feedback flows freely.

If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees

are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful

benefits we offer.

Job Title: Enterprise Deal Strategy Consultant – Finance

Role Summary

As an Enterprise Deal Strategy Consultant, you will be the decisive authority on deal approvals within the EMEA region. Your role will be pivotal in ensuring that customer proposals and contracts align with our strategic goals and financial principles. You will coordinate and manage the Enterprise C&P business, providing senior leadership with valuable insights and analysis on customer trends, deal structures, and product information. This is an outstanding opportunity to significantly influence Adobe's financial strategy while collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Deal Review, Approval & Rejection

Serve as the primary EDS approver for EMEA Enterprise deals.

Review deal structures for compliance with pricing, discounting, margin, and booking policies.

Approve or reject deals based on strategic alignment and commercial viability.

Document decisions and provide clear rationale for approvals or rejections.

Advance deals that exceed authority thresholds with detailed recommendations.

Governance & Decision Quality

Enforce consistent application of approval policies across EMEA.

Ensure decisions protect long-term revenue integrity and customer value.

Balance sales objectives with risk management through effective decision-making.

Maintain comprehensive documentation for all deal approvals.

Deal Desk Team Partnership

Partner with the Deal Desk to deliver timely and accurate assessments on customer proposals

Ensure high-quality information, analysis, and documentation is maintained observing best practises.

Review and provide feedback to ensure decision quality for output.

Quarterly Deal Analysis & Executive Reporting

Provide and present quarterly insights on EMEA deal activity, including trends and risk analysis.

Leverage data and formulate actionable reports for leadership.

Identify and recommend adjustments to policies and pricing based on recurring issues.

Strategise go-to-market with future requirements.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Communicate approval outcomes and rationale with Sales leadership.

Collaborate with Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations on critical issues.

Ensure regional consistency in deal governance by aligning with global leadership.

Required Qualifications

Degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field.

7–10+ years of background in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, or Finance.

Demonstrated experience in roles with deal approval responsibility.

Strong understanding of complex deal structures and EMEA commercial practices.

Preferred Experience

Experience working within global or matrixed organisations.

Knowledge of revenue recognition principles.

Proficiency with Dynamics and CPQ tools.

key Skills & Proficiencies

Decisive judgment and ability to challenge where necessary.

Strong financial competence and risk assessment skills.

Executive-level communication with data storytelling.

Attention to detail and a strong governance approach.

Ability to influence and initiate discussions.

Success Metrics

The Project Graph team is looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of our Graph platform, a core, highly technical product used to design, visualize, execute, and share complex workflows through graph-based systems. Project Graph powers both an advanced node-based editor and downstream, simplified experiences built on top of those graphs.

This role sits at the intersection of UX, systems design, AI-enabled workflows, and platform thinking, and requires deep empathy for advanced users such as developers, technical artists, ML practitioners, and designers.

As a principal-level PM, you will define long-term direction, tackle ambiguous problems, and work closely with engineering, design, and leadership to scale a powerful, performant, and extensible graph authoring and execution platform.

What you’ll do

Define the long-term vision and roadmap for the Graph platform, including the editor, execution model, plugins, APIs, extensibility, and interoperability across products and surfaces.

Define what “great” looks like for graph-based authoring across beginner, advanced, and expert users, including transitions between power-user tooling and simplified downstream experiences.

Lead discovery efforts to deeply understand user workflows, pain points, and mental models in graph-based and automation-driven systems.

Translate complex user needs into clear product requirements, PRDs, and success metrics across both authoring and execution.

Collaborate with design to shape interaction patterns for node creation, connections, layouts, debugging, inspection, and working at scale.

Partner closely with engineering to break down large, ambiguous problems into shippable increments without losing architectural coherence.

Work with engineers on architecture-level decisions affecting performance, data models, rendering, and execution to ensure the system performs well with large graphs and real-world workloads.

Understand and influence systems such as graph execution models, state management, serialization, versioning, and reproducibility.

Define platform primitives that enable reuse, sharing, and distribution of graph-based workflows in different contexts.

Act as a bridge between user needs and technical realities, setting clear outcomes while avoiding prescriptive implementation decisions.

What you need to succeed

8–12+ years of product management experience, with significant ownership of complex, technical, or platform products.

Prior experience with node-based editors, visual programming tools, workflow builders, automation systems, or graph-based products, direct or adjacent.

Proven track record of shipping and iterating on sophisticated user interfaces used by expert or technical users.

Strong systems thinking with the ability to reason about interconnected components, constraints, and emergent behavior.

Deep empathy for power users and creators who rely on precision, speed, debuggability, and flexibility.

Comfort working closely with highly technical engineering teams on performance-critical, architecture-heavy systems.

Ability to operate independently at a principal level while influencing cross-functional partners.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially for complex and abstract concepts.

Bonus points

Background in developer tools, creative tools, game engines, VFX pipelines, ML tooling, data platforms, or automation systems.

Familiarity with graph concepts such as DAGs, execution graphs, dependency graphs, and scheduling.

Experience with extensible platforms, plugin systems, SDKs, or scripting environments.

Experience shipping products that combine authoring tools with runtime or execution environments.

Exposure to AI-driven workflows, generative systems, or model orchestration tools.

Adobe Services Delivery is building deep and impactful partnerships with customers by investing our best thinking and resources to offer prescriptive, differentiated tools and thought leadership that help customers navigate and accelerate their digital trajectories.

Digital Strategists own the development and delivery of original, inspiring, and thought provoking workshops and strategic engagements that help customers chart their digital transformation journeys and feel confident taking the next steps—particularly in large scale, enterprise digital marketing environments leveraging Adobe Experience Cloud.

Workshop & Thought Leadership Development

Accountable for the development of workshops that foster cross functional partnerships and create practical roadmaps to help customers mature and transform their digital capabilities. Workshop materials include original assets designed to spark customer imagination and drive action on the vision established during the engagement. Deliverables may include POVs, strategy tools and methodologies, maturity models, and repeatable, hypothesis driven frameworks.

Expand existing repeatable, industry specific workshops into new industries, including associated data harvesting, analysis, collateral creation, and deliverable production.

Harvest insights from workshops to understand evolving customer needs and ensure offerings and prescriptive frameworks remain compelling, relevant, and up to date.

Author original thought leadership and compelling proposals on emerging or relevant digital themes to attract customers and drive new opportunities. Thought leadership may include proposals, frameworks, white papers, blogs, videos, and other media to support brand awareness, workshop adoption, and new business development.

Workshop & Thought Leadership Execution

Spearhead and own the delivery of high quality, consultative workshops with strong executive presence.

Engage C suite and senior executive audiences through compelling storytelling that drives action and organizational change.

Lead customers to strategic solutions that address complex business challenges using prescriptive methodologies, tools, frameworks, and high quality roadmaps.

Apply a cross discipline, entrepreneurial perspective, seamlessly adapting across topics and conversations to guide customers toward actionable outcomes.

Surface and drive new opportunities for Adobe Strategy and Readiness Services offerings.

Operations Management & Marketing

Track and monitor workshop and solution progress throughout the delivery lifecycle—from initial POVs to workshop execution, asset development, and final readouts.

Harvest and track insights and attributable operational outcomes to support reporting and growth.

Assist in the production of weekly customer impact newsletters.

Engage ecosystem stakeholders to promote workshops internally and externally, building a sustainable pipeline of customer participation.

Adobe Target

Adobe Experience Platform

GenStudio

Creative problem solver capable of translating complex, ambiguous challenges into clear, navigable frameworks.

Strong business acumen with the ability to articulate value drivers through storytelling and recognize conversational cues to deepen engagement.

Comfort navigating rapidly changing meeting dynamics and shifting priorities.

Outstanding analytical and problem solving skills, including research, data analysis, hypothesis development, and synthesis of recommendations.

Role Summary 

As a Senior Director, you will be responsible for the strategic leadership and operational excellence of Adobe’s Security organization in India. The Opportunity

As a Value Engineer within the JAPAC Ultimate Success team, you will partner closely with Value Advisors and Account Teams to build rigorous, defensible financial models that quantify the measurable business impact of Adobe’s solutions.

Your mandate is to ensure that every value claim — from revenue uplift to retention improvement and operational efficiency — is supported by structured assumptions, credible benchmarks, and CFO-ready modelling. You will operate at the intersection of finance, analytics, and strategy, translating complex product capabilities and customer data into clear economic impact models that withstand executive scrutiny.

This role is less about leading the room and more about ensuring that when we enter it, our numbers are airtight.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Modelling & Quantification

Build robust return on investment, NPV, payback, and scenario-based financial models to quantify revenue growth, retention impact, cost efficiencies, and productivity gains.

Conduct sensitivity analysis and assumption testing to ensure models remain defensible under CFO-level scrutiny.

Structure value levers clearly and prevent double-counting across impact areas.

Translate marketing, commerce, and experience metrics into financial outcomes (margin impact, lifetime value, cost avoidance).

Develop scalable modelling templates and tools to standardise value calculations across the region.

Value Workshops and Business Case Development

Partner with Value Advisors and Account Teams to convert strategic value hypotheses into quantified economic impact to support Value Workshops and Business case development.

Document assumptions transparently and apply conservative modelling principles to maintain credibility.

Reconcile customer-supplied data with benchmarks and Adobe telemetry to ensure integrity of outputs.

Support renewals and expansion cases with defensible financial analysis.

Prepare executive-ready financial summaries that simplify complex modelling into clear decision-support outputs. 

Be able to explain, communicate and answer questions on the business case or models to customer executives.

Value Realisation Analytics

Track realised versus projected value across use cases, adoption, and Net Dollar Retention (N$R).

Analyse performance data to identify value at risk, underperformance drivers, and incremental growth opportunities.

Support quarterly business reviews with updated financial insights and scenario updates.

Maintain structured measurement frameworks to ensure consistent value tracking across strategic accounts.

Benchmarking & Methodology

Understand and leverage existing Adobe tools to support Value modelling,

Maintain and refine regional industry benchmarks and modelling assumptions.

Incorporate new Adobe product capabilities into financial impact models.

Contribute to the evolution of JAPAC value modelling frameworks, templates, and playbooks.

Support automation and AI-enabled modelling to scale analytical output while maintaining rigor.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Collaborate closely with Value Advisors, Sales, Ultimate Success teams, and Professional Services to ensure alignment between strategy and quantification.

Act as the quantitative authority during value workshops, renewal planning and expansion conversations.

Provide internal coaching on modelling rigor and financial logic.

Help embed value thinking into lifecycle planning and expansion strategies.

What you bring:

5–10+ years of experience in FP&A, Commercial Finance, Deals Advisory, Valuations, Strategy Consulting, Corporate Development, or Value Engineering.

Advanced financial modelling capability (expert Excel skills required; experience with scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis essential).

Strong understanding of SaaS economics, marketing return on investment, retention modelling, and unit economics.

Proven experience building defensible arguments for enterprise technology or digital transformation programs.

High analytical rigor and comfort challenging assumptions.

Ability to translate complex financial analysis into crisp, executive-ready outputs.

Experience supporting executive-level discussions (not necessarily leading them).

Familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud (Customer Experience Orchestration) or similar Martech ecosystems preferred.

Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (especially advanced Excel).

The challenge

At Adobe, we are on a mission to deliver world-class products that empower creativity. We are looking for dedicated individuals familiar with After Effects. They enjoy finding software bugs (a.k.a breaking things), and want to ship the highest quality products. This role offers an outstanding opportunity to work with the latest digital video and animation technology. Quality Engineers are passionate about testing features, writing clear and concise bug reports, crafting test cases, verifying bug fixes, communicating effectively with developers, other quality engineers, and customers. As a Quality Engineer, you will collaborate with a dedicated team to strictly uphold our high standards, ensuring our products meet and exceed user expectations.

What you'll do

Advocate for customers and recommend features and fixes that improve their workflow.

Work with customers to better understand user workflows and reproduce their bugs.

Write clear documentation for projects and features for which you are responsible.

Implement test cases, ad hoc testing, and performance testing on new and existing features.

Perform interoperability testing between After Effects and other Adobe applications.

Collaborate with development and user experience team members to build test cases for new features.

Identify and use existing tools and test materials from other Adobe QE teams.

Isolate bugs, write detailed bug reports, and verify and regress bugs.

What you need to succeed

5+yrs experience using Adobe After Effects (familiarity with other animation, video editing, and digital audio programs is an advantage).

Experience using ExtendScript/JavaScript/typescript to build scripts.

Proven track record in testing commercially released applications.

Must meet deadlines and demonstrate outstanding attention to detail.

Strong organization skills are critical.

Strong problem-solving skills.

Solid understanding of Agile development processes and scrum.

Familiarity with Windows and Mac platforms.

Strong ability to communicate clearly and effectively in both verbal and written forms.

Ability to work independently and in a collaborative team environment.

A college degree in film or a related area is advantageous.

The Opportunity

Adobe is looking for a high-energy, driven, and self-motivated individual to join Adobe's Customer Experience Orchestration team as an Associate Business Development Representative supporting our Business Development, Marketing and Sales teams.

This is a net new early in career business development role, and as such, you will be given the opportunity to learn, grow and be successful in understanding the Adobe solutions for the Customer Experience Orchestration business.

In this role, you will be our first line of contact with prospects. You will excel in establishing meaningful conversations with a variety of IT and C-level decision makers in a variety of industries, and you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop target accounts to generate sales-ready meetings and opportunities.
 

Through account-based sales development, you will identify and build sales pipeline that leads to revenue growth. As a starter role in Adobe, you will have the opportunity to work across a number of different industries, business personas and teams. This role is ideal for a highly motivated early-in-career professional who is resilient and keen to learn new skills in building and executing business development prospecting.

Measurement

As a SDR, you will be asked to sit in differing Business Development roles. Your day to day activities will be at times across differing segments within the organisation. In the future, as your success continues, you will be moved to a dedicated account patch, once your area of specialisation is uncovered and developed. The compensation is 70:30, with ramp sales targets initially.

What You’ll Do:

Generate sales pipeline through inbound/outbound prospecting activities via telephone, video, and email

Build awareness into the account base through regular email campaigns, drive attendance to live and online webinars and assist with event/webinar follow ups.

Research accounts, identify key players, generate interest and develop accounts to uncover and develop opportunities for Adobe’s products.

Handle and overcome prospect objections with confidence.

Become a trusted resource and develop positive relationships with your sales ecosystem and peers.

Update CRM, Outreach, and other tools as necessary to ensure the capture of key activity history & ensure a smooth hand-off to the Account Executive as necessary.

Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Adobe's competitive positioning in the marketplace.

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline generating targets to ensure territory revenue objectives and pipeline linearity.

What You Will Need to Succeed

1–3 years of relevant experience.

A track record of achieving measurable sales goals, in IT, or any other sales-focused environment.

Attention to detail to support accurate entry and management of lead data in a CRM system as required.

Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing and presentation skills

An interest in sales prospecting tactics and technologies.

An interest in marketing technologies.

An interest in developing and learning new skills.

Motivated by individual and team achievement.

Highly organised with the ability to work in fast-paced environment.

Resilience.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a high-energy, driven, and self-motivated individual to join our Japan Creativity & Productivity (C&P) BDR team in Tokyo. As a BDR(Business Development Representative), you will be the first point of contact for prospects, engaging with IT and C-level decision-makers across commercial and public sectors. You’ll play a meaningful role in generating pipeline through personalized outreach and account-based development strategies. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with a passion to succeed!

What You’ll Do

Generate qualified pipeline through inbound and outbound prospecting via phone, video, email, and social channels.

Research and identify key contacts within target accounts to initiate meaningful conversations.

Build awareness and interest in Adobe’s Creativity & Productivity solutions (Creative Cloud, Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Sign, Firefly Services, etc.).

Drive attendance to webinars and live events through targeted campaigns.

Collaborate with Account Executives, Marketing, and Product teams to align messaging and strategy.

Keep accurate records in CRM and contribute to pipeline progression and forecasting.

Handle objections confidently and guide prospects through the qualification process.

Participate in ongoing enablement sessions and contribute to team best practices.

Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Adobe's competitive positioning in the marketplace.
 

What You Need to Succeed

Full fluency in Japanese and preferred reading and writing in English.

1+ years’ experience in IT sales or business development, ideally with enterprise clients.

Proven success in inbound/outbound prospecting and building relationships across organizational levels.

Skilled in account planning, opportunity qualification, and objection handling.

Strong communicator with confident phone, writing, and presentation skills.

Quick learner able to translate complex business needs into solution plays.

Proficient in tools like Salesforce CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, Outreach, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and MS Office or similar.

Self-starter with resilience, independence, and a collaborative attitude.

Comfortable working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and solution teams.

The opportunity 

As Business Development Representatives (BDR) you are responsible for helping individuals, teams, and enterprises unleash creativity and productivity with industry-leading tools like Creative Cloud, Acrobat, and Adobe Express. 

 

What you’ll do 

You are the main driving force for identifying and providing high-value opportunities into the Sales pipeline. You are the first line of relationship development with prospective high-value accounts!
 

Build awareness and interest in Adobe’s Creativity & Productivity solutions (Creative Cloud, Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Sign, Firefly Services, etc.). 

Deliver a “consultative” approach to selling; taking time to understand the prospect’s business, their goals, objectives, and challenges before recommending a solution. 

Consistently achieve quality pipeline, progression of them & other metrics such as Inbound lead follow-up & outbound account engagement metrics. 

Manage territory creation plan for your key account executives & their accounts. Researching key accounts, identifying decision-makers, generating interest, and developing accounts to stimulate opportunity. 

Prospect, educate, qualify, and develop Target Accounts and inbound leads to create sales ready leads and opportunities. 

Quickly route prospects and current customers to appropriate colleagues to assist in solving problems and driving value. Nurtures & provides education on areas of interest for under-informed customers. 

Setup, attend & run qualification meetings with customers in partnership with relevant Account Executive & Solution Consultants. Updating CRM, Outreach, and other tools as necessary to ensure capture of key history & ensuring a smooth hand-off to the relevant Account Executive as necessary. 

Exceed monthly and quarterly targets for qualified pipeline opportunities. 

Providing closed-loop feedback to ensure continuous process optimisation. 

What you need to succeed:

2 years of experience as a BDR or in a similar role, specifically supporting the creative industry space. 

Track record of successful business development in software, or a tech sales environment. Knowledge of creatives within an agency environment would be an advantage. 

Self-starter with high motivation, independence, resilience, and ability to collaborate with sales & marketing teams to deliver pipe creation goals. 

Proven sales skills delivering inbound & outbound experiences and building strong relationships at multiple levels within an organisation. 

Strong communication including listening, written, and verbal skills 

Experience managing all areas of the BDR process including account planning, pre-call preparation, opportunity qualification, and objection handling. 

Ability to quickly learn & understand sophisticated business problems & translate customers' needs into solutions plays. 

Consistently achieving inside sales goals in an automated sales environment where accurate entry and management of lead data in a CRM system was required. 

Positive & upbeat personality who loves to spend time engaging customers through phone, social media & email. Curious to learn; always be asking questions! 

Proficient with standard corporate productivity tools (email, voicemail, MS Office) and experience with sales tools such as Microsoft Dynamics, SFDC, Outreach, ZoomInfo, Lusha, etc. 

Strong time management and ability to ruthlessly prioritise key tasks

Accountable for Customer’s overall success with Adobe, including vision planning, customer health, multi-solution adoption, and measurable impact through the lens of industry specialization

Exceptional organizational, presentation, and communication skills, both verbal and written

Existing knowledge of software in digital marketing and/or digital media space, including data platforms, content management and customer journeys

Skilled at Program Management within large organizations, helping to inspire change across groups by engaging key partners

Effective at leading executive C-level discussions and presentations

Flexibility to travel (approx. 30%)

The Opportunity 

At Adobe, we're committed to helping our customers deliver unparalleled digital experiences and are looking for a passionate individual to accelerate the effectiveness of our digital marketing motion through data, insights, and innovative measurement methods! In the Enterprise Analytics team, we are tasked with optimizing the performance of the Digital Demand Generation activities through proactive analysis, enablement, and measurement innovation. We are passionate about diving deep into data, building reporting solutions and driving insights to help our partners scale efficiently.
 

The Digital Marketing Analytics Lead will serve as a strategic partner to the Digital Demand Generation organization. This role will drive regular inspection and proactive insights to optimize our marketing performance on the web as well as mentor junior analysts. This role will report, in person regularly to our San Jose, CA Headquarters.
 

What you'll Do 

Drive strategic analytics initiatives to improve the efficiency and impact of our global digital marketing spend with a focus on our paid and owned channels

Lead biweekly performance inspection reviews investigating strategic shifts and providing recommendations

Build out a testing and optimization roadmap for our digital media, with regular readouts on test performance

Combine qualitative and quantitative insights to drive channel and customer-segment level insights that inform targeting, creative optimization and budget allocation strategies

Own the relationship with the Digital Media and Demand Journey leaders, influencing marketing strategy and roadmap priorities

Mentor and guide junior analysts to provide impactful insights and improve the overall quality of analysis.
 

What You Need to Succeed 

Degree in Marketing, Statistics, Business Administration or other relevant fields

7+ years of experience in a marketing science/analytics role in a B2B environment, including with Account-Based Marketing, or as part of a media agency

Experience with SQL and Data Visualization Tools (Tableau, PowerBI etc.)

Deep understanding of digital and offline marketing strategies, funnel optimization, engagement metrics and customer lifetime value optimization

Familiarity with marketing measurement frameworks like MTA, MMM, incrementality testing, A/B and multivariate testing and brand lift studies

Proficient in paid media tracking technologies like UTM frameworks, Adobe Launch, Adobe Analytics, pixels, and conversion APIs across platforms including Meta, LinkedIn, and Google Ads.

Demonstrated experience supporting digital demand generation functions to drive strategic insights and performance improvement

Strong communicator with a strategic attitude - comfortable working cross-functionally and presenting to senior leadership.

Experience with mentoring or managing junior analysts

Highly entrepreneurial and able to operate independently with minimal direction

(Preferred but not required) Experience in driving or optimizing your own digital marketing campaigns. We love former marketeers who can bring their analytics chops as well as speak the marketing language.

Ability to work in person out of the San Jose, CA headquarters 2-3 times weekly required.

The Opportunity

The Adobe Customer Solutions Engagement Manager leads substantial, innovative engagements for critical Adobe accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor and strategic guide, you help Sales and Delivery teams align projects with customers’ objectives. Recognized as a business contributor and delivery specialist, you are the primary customer contact in a billable capacity. You drive the delivery of desired results while preserving strong executive connections.

This position merges excellent delivery and client relationship supervision, concentrating on client and partner communication, cross-functional teamwork, and technical skills to advance business transformation. Success requires collaborating across people, process, and technology with an industry or customer practitioner perspective to produce measurable customer value.

What You'll Do

Customer Engagement & Delivery Leadership

The role manages the success of a defined set of strategic Services customers in the region. It ensures customer requirements are met and that engagements deliver measurable business value aligned to customer priorities. It acts as the primary contact for customer executives and coordinates with partners across the customer’s broader ecosystem. After contract booking, it ensures a smooth and efficient transition from Sales to Delivery. It works closely with Sales, Delivery, and Product teams to align on customer success plans and find opportunities to drive value across Adobe solutions. It serves as the main point of contact at senior management level, resolving customer issues quickly and keeping engagements on track.

Operational Excellence

You are responsible for driving accurate and effective revenue management, including growth and margin execution, revenue acceleration, backlog burn, contract expiration and extension management, and close alignment with Adobe Finance and Operations.

You manage the Services team by coordinating team staffing, onboarding, and transitions within the assigned account(s).

Services Expansion & Opportunity Development

You will partner closely with Adobe Sales to build new services opportunities and support contract extensions, change requests, and addendum. You contribute strategic feedback to account planning in collaboration with the wider account teams, and lead efforts to renew and expand Customer Solutions relationships with existing clients by demonstrating a deep understanding of customer objectives and the scope, activities, and resources required to achieve them.

What you'll need to succeed

8+ years of hands-on experience in professional services, consulting or customer delivery experience of large programs, preferably in SaaS or enterprise software.

Experience with enterprise level project or program management.

Proven track record of building positive relationships, managing complex customer engagements and leading transformation.

Passion for operational rigor and customer value, with a proven ability to collaborate, lead and influence in a matrixed organization.

Strong business insight and industry expertise with ability to speak to value drivers and use cases in customer's context via experience-based story telling.

Ability to effectively navigate complex client situations and act as a change agent for our clients and within Adobe Services.

Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Danish and English, executive level presence and experience in working in a client advisory role.

Able to travel to support client engagements.

Bachelor’s degree, with an MBA or equivalent experience preferred.

Digital marketing experience is preferred.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to drive opportunity within our Experience Cloud business. You will be responsible for exceeding sales targets through the sale of Adobe's leading edge Customer Experience Orchestration solutions, delivering net new revenue from an assigned greenfield account base. The ideal candidate is someone with a “hunter” mentality who excels at prospecting, consultative value selling, closing deals, and winning! If you are a motivated individual with an entrepreneurial mentality, we want to hear from you.

What you'll Do

Drive new customer acquisition for Adobe’s Customer Experience Orchestration solutions by implementing targeted sales strategies, overcoming objections, and creating compelling business cases and selling events that lead to first-time adoption.

Manage your time and territory by prioritizing accounts, aligning activities for maximum impact, and balancing short-term wins with long-term growth opportunities.

Collaborate within a matrixed ecosystem including internal sales and cross-functional teams (Product, Marketing, Legal, Finance) to align resources, enhance value, and deliver a unified customer experience.

Establish and expand executive relationships through thoughtful, ongoing engagement — gaining access to senior decision-makers (e.g., VP, SVP, CxO), leveraging champions, and crafting shareable, value-driven communications.

Stay informed on customer needs, competitive dynamics, and market trends, contributing thought leadership and sharing insights across peers and teams.

Become a trusted advisor by uncovering customer business problems, aligning Adobe's Customer Experience Orchestration solutions to their strategic objectives, and delivering persuasive cases that clearly demonstrate the impact of our value.

Use data and insights to manage complex sales cycles, guide strategic business reviews, ensure forecast accuracy, and consistently progress deals across your territory.

Perform outbound selling activities and partner with internal Marketing teams to generate demand, build credibility with customers, and create a compelling vision to drive urgency and justify investment for your customers.

What you need to succeed

Resilience, adaptability and strong negotiation skills.

Proactiveness, competitiveness, and ability to exceed sales targets.

Awareness of trends and customer-focused.

Persuasiveness, clear communication, and effective presentation.

Trust, collaboration, and account management.

Self-awareness, open-mindedness, and curiosity.

Bold in outbound selling; skilled at creating urgency.

Strategic in managing and maintaining accounts.

Bachelor's Degree and 1 year of experience OR 3 years of equivalent practical experience.

Minimum 3 years of experience in SaaS sales.

3+ years of experience with marketing technology solutions and/or consultative platform sales preferred.

Who We Are

We deliver digital government solutions that put people first. Our software is trusted by the U.S. Department of Defense and other federal agencies to drive digital transformation, modernize citizen engagement, and enhance secure collaboration across government networks.

Our enterprise software and cloud services empower agencies to create, manage, and measure digital content — from electronic documents and forms to workflow automation, content management, analytics, and collaboration. With a strong focus on security and compliance, we provide authorized government solutions with the Authority to Operate (ATO) in sensitive federal environments.

What You’ll Do

To support our growing public sector portfolio, we’re seeking a results-oriented professional with deep National Security experience and a strong understanding of federal mission priorities.

As a Strategic Account Executive, you will:

Develop, maintain, and execute a business plan for your assigned vertical, aligning customer needs with Adobe’s strategic direction.

Create a Strategic Account Plan that defines sales strategy, identifies growth opportunities, and expands Adobe’s footprint across key accounts.

Build and sustain SES-level relationships with CIOs, Directors, and Mission Leaders, communicating value through ROI-based discussions that connect technology with mission outcomes.

Lead and influence cross-functional teams—including presales, consulting, and partner management—without direct authority, driving collaboration toward shared goals.

Demonstrate strong business acumen, managing accurate forecasts, pipelines, and providing regular business health updates to senior leadership.

Negotiate complex federal contracts, coordinating across Legal, Contracts, Operations, and Technical teams.

Ensure all activities adhere to strict security and compliance standards required for federal operations.

What You’ll Need

Bachelor’s degree (MBA preferred)

Minimum 5 years of enterprise software sales experience within the federal government or national security community

Mastery of one or more sales methodologies (e.g., Value Selling, Challenger, SPIN, etc.)

Experience with cloud and SaaS technologies

Exceptional written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills

Active Top Secret clearance (TS/SCI preferred) or the ability to obtain one

The Opportunity 

We are seeking a highly skilled Information Retrieval Engineer to lead the development and optimization of retrieval systems that power context-aware large language models (LLMs). This role focuses on building robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ensure AI agents and applications have access to the most relevant, timely, and high-quality information.

You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and knowledge management—enabling better reasoning, accuracy, and performance for enterprise-grade AI systems.

What you'll Do 

RAG System Design

Architect and deploy scalable retrieval pipelines using vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant)

Implement semantic search infrastructure and hybrid retrieval systems (semantic + keyword)

Data Processing & Ingestion

Build ingestion pipelines for both structured and unstructured data sources

Implement document chunking strategies, embedding generation (e.g., OpenAI, Cohere, HuggingFace), and metadata tagging

Retrieval Optimization

Fine-tune relevance scoring, reranking algorithms, and query understanding mechanisms

Develop techniques to improve precision/recall for specific business domains or user tasks

Knowledge Enhancement

Create and maintain knowledge graphs to support context linking and disambiguation

Manage data freshness and version control to ensure consistency and reliability of retrieved content

Reasoning Support

Design and iterate on context window strategies that improve LLM reasoning (e.g., adaptive injection, task-based retrieval)

Collaborate with prompt engineers and model developers to align retrieval outputs with downstream model behavior

Performance Monitoring

Track key retrieval metrics such as accuracy, latency, and fallback rate

Implement caching, prefetching, and deduplication strategies to optimize system responsiveness

What you need to succeed 

4+ years in data engineering, ML infrastructure, or information retrieval

Experience building and deploying RAG pipelines or semantic search systems

Strong ML and Python skills and familiarity with retrieval libraries (e.g., Haystack, LangChain, Elasticsearch, Milvus)

Proficiency with embedding models, vector similarity search, and document indexing

Familiarity with cloud platforms and MLOps tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Docker)

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, TigerGraph) or knowledge graph design

Experience optimizing retrieval for LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral)

Background in IR/NLP, Search Engineering, or Cognitive Computing

Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

Adobe is seeking a Staff Machine Learning Engineer/Architect to lead the development of next-generation personalization models and intelligent AI agents within Adobe Experience Platform (AEP).
Our team is building intelligent agent systems that can autonomously design, generate, optimize, and evaluate personalization models at scale. These agents reason over customer data, business objectives, and experimentation signals to create adaptive models that continuously improve digital experiences.
As a senior member of the AI team, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of personalization AI systems, from research and modeling to production deployment, monitoring, and MLOps automation. You will work at the intersection of personalization modeling, multimodal LLMs, agentic reasoning, real-time decisioning, and enterprise-scale ML infrastructure.
This role is ideal for engineers and applied scientists who want to build production-grade AI systems that autonomously power personalization, targeting, ranking, and next-best-action strategies across billions of interactions.
You’ll collaborate closely with Adobe Research, Product Management, and Platform Engineering to ensure AI-driven personalization is not an add-on—but a foundational capability embedded across Adobe’s Customer Experience Orchestration products.

What You’ll Do

Design and build advanced personalization models including propensity models, recommendation models and systems, uplift models, reinforcement learning, and generative personalization systems.

Develop LLM-powered intelligent agents that can generate and tune personalization models, automate experimentation and model optimization and recommend next-best-actions and targeting strategies

Architect and implement end-to-end ML systems, including:

Feature engineering pipelines (batch and streaming)

Model training and evaluation frameworks

Low-latency inference systems

Build and scale real-time decisioning systems that operate across high-throughput enterprise environments.

Lead MLOps initiatives, including CI/CD for ML, model versioning, monitoring, drift detection, automated retraining, and performance governance.

Drive system reliability, scalability, and observability across distributed ML services.

Partner with product leaders to translate personalization strategy into measurable business impact.

Mentor engineers on modern ML practices, agentic AI design, and production grade ML architecture.

Champion responsible AI and personalization practices, focusing on interpretability, fairness, safety, and user trust.

What You Need to Succeed

Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of experience, or PhD with 5+ years building and deploying ML systems at scale.

Deep expertise in personalization systems, recommendation models, or real-time decisioning architectures.

Some experience with LLMs, agentic systems, prompt engineering, RAG, or context engineering, especially in production environments.

Proven success building and shipping end-to-end ML systems, from research to deployment and ongoing optimization.

Hands-on experience with MLOps best practices, including model lifecycle management, monitoring, automated retraining, CI/CD for ML, and large-scale inference systems.

Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace, LangChain, or equivalent.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to connect modeling decisions to business metrics such as lift, engagement, and customer lifetime value.

Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and demonstrated technical leadership.

Experience bridging research and production in enterprise scale AI applications.

The Opportunity
 

The candidate will be part of Adobe’s Enterprise Marketing Global Marketing Labs and lead the narrative strategy, copy governance, and messaging excellence process for customer content and assets.

Adobe is looking for someone who can champion the brand voice, drive consistency and clarity in messaging, master content governance processes, and bring new efficiencies through the adoption of GenAI in copy development and editorial workflows.
 

The ideal candidate should be a strategic storyteller, an editorial leader, and a strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with Adobe Studio, internal marketing teams, product teams, and agency partners to elevate narrative quality across channels.

Bring your organizational and communication skills to our diverse, dedicated team of dreamers, doers, and brand builders.
 

What You’ll Do

Lead the narrative strategy and messaging architecture for Global Marketing Labs, defining positioning, tone, and storytelling frameworks for campaigns, product launches, and brand initiatives we support.

Ensure all copy and messaging align with brand goals, audience needs, and business strategy.

Maintain deep product and customer understanding to guide development and implementation of compelling insightful narratives.

Drive Messaging Architecture, Brand Voice Governance, and Content Expression Systems to ensure consistency across assets and channels.

Play a crucial role in shaping and reviewing copy across touchpoints (web, campaigns, thought leadership, email, social, video scripts, etc.), ensuring clarity, differentiation, and impact.

Interpret creative briefs and set the narrative and messaging direction for internal teams and external agencies.

Develop high-level narrative platforms and storylines that form the foundation for integrated marketing initiatives.

Safeguard brand identity by ensuring all content reflects Adobe’s voice, tone, and positioning standards.

Establish and evolve editorial guidelines, governance models, and review frameworks to scale quality across global teams.

Collaborate actively with business units, campaign leads, product marketing, and cross-functional teams to align on positioning and storytelling strategy.

Stay ahead of industry trends, content innovation, AI-enabled writing practices, and evolving audience expectations.

Mentor writers, content strategists, and agency partners—raising the bar for narrative craft and strategic storytelling.

Represent Adobe at conferences, blogs, and thought leadership platforms as a voice for brand storytelling and enterprise content excellence.
 

What Is Needed to Succeed

12+ years’ experience in brand storytelling, content strategy, editorial leadership, or related roles.

Demonstrated expertise in messaging frameworks, positioning strategy, and narrative architecture.

Experience leading and reviewing multi-channel content initiatives from concept to execution.

Strong understanding of content governance, brand voice systems, and scaling editorial excellence across teams.

Familiarity with GenAI tools and automation in content creation workflows.

Exceptional writing, editing, and narrative refinement skills.

Ability to articulate messaging rationale and storytelling strategy to a broad, cross-functional audience.

Strong presentation and executive communication skills.

Ability to work effectively in a fast-moving environment, anticipate challenges, and think big-picture.

A positive attitude dedicated to raising the quality and impact of enterprise storytelling.

The Challenge

Adobe is looking for an exceptional Developer focused on platform engineering, automation, and engineering intelligence to join an engineering productivity team. In this role, you will build and improve systems developed to scale and support engineering workflows. You will also handle telemetry integration, automation, and visibility across client, online, and handheld device platforms.

You will help architect resilient services that integrate CI/CD, automation, developer, and operational signals into scalable systems that deliver reliable and actionable insights. Building software at Adobe’s scale requires platforms that are fast, dependable, secure, and designed to support engineers effectively.

If you enjoy solving complex problems and building systems that improve how large engineering teams build, measure, and operate software, this role is for you.

What you’ll do

Develop and maintain scalable backend services and automation frameworks that support Desktop, Web, and Mobile environments.

Design and evolve infrastructure that powers engineering workflows, operational visibility, and system insights.

Build modern web interfaces and dashboards that translate complex telemetry into clear, actionable insights.

Drive end-to-end automation to streamline workflows and provide reliable access to build, quality, system, and engineering health signals.

Partner with product and engineering teams to improve developer experience, engineering confidence, and data-driven decision making.

Apply data analysis and AI or ML techniques to extract insights from engineering telemetry and improve automation.

Evaluate and enforce application, operating system, and security requirements across automation and infrastructure systems.

Maintain version control and infrastructure-as-code practices that ensure reproducibility, scalability, and reliability.

What you need to succeed

Experience defining engineering metrics and building dashboards or reporting systems that surface operational and quality insights.

2–3 years of hands-on experience with languages such as Python, JavaScript, or similar backend technologies with strong service development experience.

Experience building modern web applications and visualization layers using contemporary frontend frameworks and web technologies.

Production experience with containerization and orchestration solutions, for example Docker and Kubernetes.

Experience building and operating services including

CI and CD integrations

Monitoring and alerting platforms such as Splunk, Prometheus, and New Relic

Kubernetes-based deployments

Infrastructure as code and provisioning tools such as Terraform, SaltStack, or similar

Data ingestion, processing, and analytics pipelines

Experience designing APIs and backend services that consume, transform, and expose engineering workflow data.

Exposure to AI, ML, or intelligent systems used to analyze operational data and generate insights.

Ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt to evolving problem spaces.

Ability to write and maintain high-quality, well-tested code.

Strong debugging skills across distributed systems and the ability to deliver sustainable architectural solutions.

Experience working with large and globally distributed engineering teams where automation, visibility, and data-driven insights are critical.

Ability to clearly document system architecture, operational workflows, and APIs.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

A practical systems-thinking attitude and comfort operating in complex platform environments.

The Opportunity

The Global Integrated Marketing team drives Adobe’s enterprise B2B marketing strategy by crafting cohesive, cross-channel campaigns that connect with audiences worldwide and ensure every touchpoint reflects business objectives, on-brand messaging, and customer needs.

We’re seeking a Principal to lead a set of global B2B marketing campaigns and own the end-to-end strategy—from planning and orchestration to performance analysis! This role will partner closely across the marketing ecosystem on execution, messaging, and content development to drive measurable results. Do you enjoy working cross-functionally and seeing your campaign vision come to life? We'd love for you to join our team.

Responsibilities

Campaign Strategy: Lead the development of marketing strategies that span regions and channels and align marketing goals with overall business objectives and target audience needs.

Channel coordination and consistency: Streamline efforts across cross-functional teams to implement campaigns effectively and ensure a unified strategy across marketing channels.

Market & customer knowledge: Stay on top of innovation and industry trends, competitive landscape, marketing capabilities, customer behavior, and new technologies to inform campaign strategy. Have an in-depth knowledge of common business challenges our customers face and how Adobe products help solve those challenges.

Reporting and optimization: Monitor and report on marketing campaigns, using metrics to assess performance and optimizations needed. Develop and communicate insights, optimizations, and/or pivots needed through run-the-business and quarterly business reviews.

Cross-functional influence & accountability: Extensively collaborate and influence key team members, working closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Digital and Events centers of excellence, BDRs, and senior leadership. Communicate effectively at various levels regarding marketing objectives and outcomes.

Deliverables and Outcomes

Development and communication of end-to-end campaigns planned and in market

Facilitate a degree of coordination across centers-of-excellence and for the execution of campaigns across channel, content, and related teams

Ensure consistent messaging and alignment across all channels

End-to-end campaign performance analysis and insights, including finding opportunities for optimization that elevate the impact of our B2B marketing

What’s Needed to Succeed:

Significant experience in B2B marketing planning, including managing a range of marketing programs and tactics.

Proven ability to design and implement global, multi-channel campaigns that align with business priorities and drive measurable outcomes.

Strong background in analysis and performance optimization, including reporting and insights to inform pivots and improve return on investment.

Outstanding communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.

Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments—anticipating challenges and proactively solving them.

Skilled at influencing and steering large-scale initiatives without direct authority, with a positive attitude that encourages collaboration and momentum!

Clear, informed perspective on what 'good' looks like across all facets of campaign marketing.

You will bridge business goals and technical delivery by designing target architectures, planning transitions, and creating decommissioning strategies. Using change management frameworks such as ADKAR, you'll support adoption and sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

Assess and advance the architectural intent crafted during pre-sales.

Provide architectural leadership across the full transformation lifecycle and guide platform adoption and evolution.

Convert the success roadmap created during pre-sales into a comprehensive, managed transition plan featuring clear sequencing, decision points, and risk controls.

Formulate robust, industry-specific architectural perspectives and translate them into target-state architecture, reference models, and phased implementation plans.

Foster and maintain executive trust in architectural direction, serving as a strategic advisor to senior business and technology collaborators.

Collaborate with licensing and services sales teams to improve major sales initiatives.

Coordinate architectural efforts among delivery teams, subject matter experts, and partners to ensure build integrity and alignment during execution.

Establish and lead architecture governance and assurance forums.

Partner closely with pre‑sales teams to ensure lessons learned, build patterns, and reference architectures continually improve future pursuits and delivery outcomes.

What you’ll need to succeed

Proven experience providing enterprise architecture leadership across large-scale transformation programmes, from early visioning and pre-sales through delivery, adoption, and platform evolution.

Strong grounding in TOGAF principles and lifecycle-based architecture governance, applied pragmatically in complex enterprise environments.

Broad understanding of digital marketing, data, and activation ecosystems.

The ability to craft compelling narratives that translate architectural choices into business-relevant results and messages suitable for executives.

Experience operating as a trusted architectural advisor to senior executives.

Strong understanding of AI, automation, and emerging agentic models, and their implications for enterprise platforms.

Experience working closely with delivery teams, partners, and vendors to maintain build integrity.

Ability to apply structured change and adoption approaches (including ADKAR) to support the human and organisational aspects of architectural evolution.

A collaborative, outcome-focused leadership style, with a relentless focus on value and adoption.

Fluency in English and German is required. Any other european language would be a plus.

Role Summary: 

The Professional Development Enablement Creator will play a critical role within the Customer Solutions & Innovation Team and focuses on designing, developing, and curating educational content, training materials, and resources to improve employee performance and professional growth. This role typically acts as a bridge between subject matter experts (SMEs) and the workforce, turning complex information into engaging, actionable, and scalable learning experiences, often using tools like Learning Management Systems (LMS), video, and interactive modules. The Professional Development Enablement Creator must be a proactive problem-solver with strong customer-first thinking, attention to detail, understanding program management and an eye for user experience. 

What You’ll Do: 

Content Creation & Development: Design, write, and produce training materials, including e-learning modules, videos, job aids, playbooks, and self-service resources. 

Strategy Execution: Collaborate with business leaders, SMEs and individual contributors to execute leadership vision & strategy and create role-specific learning paths. 

Content Management & Design: Owning the content management for enablement resources and design for easy navigation for end user. 

Curriculum & Asset Management: Maintain a centralized repository of training materials (LMS), ensuring content is accurate, up-to-date, and easily searchable. 

Impact Analysis: Monitor the adoption and effectiveness of training initiatives through data, analytics, and feedback to ensure continuous improvement. 

Onboarding & Development: Develop and maintain structured onboarding programs to accelerate time-to-productivity for new hires. 
 

What You’ll Need to Succeed: 

Bachelor's degree required in Change Management, Organizational Design, Communications, Marketing, Education, or similar field. 

5+ years of proven experience in video editing or content creation, particularly in a corporate or educational setting and preferably in a SaaS or technology company. 

Proficiency in e-learning software, learning management systems and video creation tools. 

A portfolio demonstrating excellence in diverse content creation, editing styles and, ideally, education content. 

Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain continuity, pacing, and visual storytelling standards. 

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional, agile team environment. 

Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. 

Experience in a customer-centric or customer solutions environment is highly preferred. 

Experience with technical delivery of the Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration product suite is a plus. 

 

Performance Measurement: 

This role will be measured against a predefined Business-Driven Objective (BDO) that aligns with Adobe Consulting’s strategic goals. The BDO will focus on: 

Increased Time to Value 

Consistent usage of Role-based operating rhythms, included delivery role definitions and rationalization 

Increased automations in delivery processes 

Increased asset reusability 

Defined framework for cross training strategy 

 

Progress toward the BDO will be reviewed quarterly and used to guide performance feedback, team alignment, and strategic prioritization.
