Senior Data Engineer & Architect

Location: San Jose, CA

Job Type: Full-Time

Reporting to: Senior Manager, Data & Analytics Platform Engineering

About the Role

The Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) Product Success Engineering team is hiring a Senior Data Engineer & Architect to help build and scale the infrastructure that powers product adoption insights, customer retention analytics, system performance monitoring, and operational intelligence across Adobe.

In this role, you will design and build reliable, scalable, cloud-native data systems while contributing to platform-wide architectural direction and standards. You’ll collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, Solution Architects, and Product partners to translate evolving business needs into durable data solutions that support analytics and machine learning use cases.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on engineering while influencing broader data architecture strategy.

What You’ll Do

Design & Evolve the Data Platform

Partner with engineering leadership to develop and evolve enterprise-scale data architecture across warehouses, lakes, and modern data platforms.

Develop logical and physical data models crafted to enable analytics and ML use cases, including dimensional models and optimized schemas.

Contribute to platform standards, reference architectures, and documentation across ingestion, transformation, governance, and analytics enablement.

Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture and Cloud Infrastructure teams to align with security, compliance, performance, and cost optimization guidelines.

Build Scalable Data Pipelines

Design, develop, and maintain reliable ETL/ELT pipelines integrating data from usage, clickstream, entitlement, cost, and support systems.

Build modular, reusable pipeline frameworks using orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect.

Optimize data processing workflows for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency using distributed systems (e.g., Spark, Beam).

Work with Data Scientists and Analytics Engineers to operationalize data products and ML-ready datasets.

Strengthen Governance, Quality & Reliability

Design and implement scalable frameworks for managing and improving data integrity, including cataloging, lineage tracking, access controls, and automated validation processes to ensure trusted, production-grade data.

Establish and continuously improve reliability standards for data services, defining and tracking key SLOs such as freshness, pipeline success rates, and availability through proactive monitoring and alerting.

Maintain clear metadata, documentation, and data definitions to improve discoverability, enable self-service analytics, and support consistent operational excellence across the platform.

What You’ll Bring

Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

8+ years of experience in data engineering or software engineering, including building and operating production data platforms.

Experience contributing to data architecture decisions at the system or platform level.

Technical Expertise

Strong experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift), including schema design and performance tuning.

Experience building production-grade pipelines using orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect) and distributed processing tools (Spark, Beam).

Deep understanding of ETL/ELT patterns, dimensional modeling, and analytics dataset design.

Experience implementing data governance and quality practices, including lineage, validation, and role-based access controls.

Proficiency in Scale or Java, plus experience Python & SQL

Experience working with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Experience defining data modeling standards, naming conventions, and data contracts.

Familiarity with event-driven and streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis).

Communication & Collaboration

Ability to translate business questions into scalable data models and platform capabilities.

Ability to clearly explain data and architectural concepts to diverse audiences.

Nice to Have

Experience in B2B SaaS, product analytics, or customer success environments.

Hands-on experience with modern data stack tools (dbt, Great Expectations, Atlan, Collibra).

Exposure to MLOps concepts such as feature pipelines and training datasets.

Why Join This Team

Develop the architecture of a critical data platform used across Adobe.

Combine hands-on engineering with meaningful architectural influence.

Work with modern cloud and data technologies at enterprise scale.

Collaborate with experienced Data Science, Analytics, and Platform Engineering teams.

If you’re passionate about building reliable, scalable data systems and influencing platform strategy, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role

Join the AIF India Foundation team as an AIML Applied Engineer. In this role, you will develop and grow the AI Assistant and agentic core for Adobe Express. These components support Assistant experiences across multiple products. The job centers on server-side tasks. You will build and deploy AI/ML models and microservices, integrate external AI/ML providers, and keep AI features for Express users dependable and scalable.

What we offer

Contribute to Adobe Express and AI Assistant that serve millions of creators.

Build agentic and cross-product AI experiences with a strong engineering and research team.

Exposure to brand new AI/ML and cloud-native systems at scale.

Encouraging and unified setting at AIF India Foundation and Adobe.

What you'll do

AI Assistant development: Build, implement, and maintain server-side components of the Adobe Express AI Assistant (APIs, orchestration, state, tool use).

Agentic core: Contribute to the agentic core that enables cross-Assistant interaction and multi-product workflows (routing, context, handoffs).

Microservices: Develop and improve microservices that deliver AI Assistant and agentic functionalities to clients and other services.

Third-party AI/ML integration: Deploy and manage AI/ML models and APIs (e.g., LLMs, embeddings, specialised models); oversee authentication, retry mechanisms, fallback strategies, and balance cost versus latency.

Cloud & platform: Manage services within cloud environments (e.g., AWS/GCP/Azure); use containers, orchestration, and platform tools for deployment and monitoring.

Reliability & observability: Integrate logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting; participate in on-call duties and incident management.

Collaboration: Work with product, build, and other engineering teams to ship features and improve AI quality and user experience.

Qualifications

Required

4–6 years of software engineering experience, including significant participation in applied AI/ML (model integration, deployment, or ML systems).

BS/BTech (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.

Strong background in server-side development with one or more of the following: JavaScript, Typescript, Python, Node.js; knowledge of REST/gRPC and asynchronous patterns.

Hands-on cloud experience (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure): compute, storage, networking, and managed services.

Solid data structures, algorithms, and system building; comfort with concurrency, scaling, and fault tolerance.

Experience with microservices: build, APIs, service boundaries, and deployment (e.g., containers, Kubernetes or similar).

Preferred

Experience with agentic systems: agents, tool use, planning, or multi-step reasoning in production.

Experience with LLM APIs (e.g., chat, completions, embeddings) and timely response handling at scale.

Familiarity with MLOps practices: model versioning, A/B testing, canary releases, or feature stores.

Experience with observability (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry) and on-call for production services.

Experience in creative or build tools (e.g., Express, Creative Cloud) or conversational AI products.

Experience with AI/ML in production: incorporating or launching models (e.g., LLMs, embeddings, classifiers); understanding of latency, efficiency, and failure modes.

Experience integrating third-party AI/ML APIs or models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, or internal model services).

The Opportunity

Adobe is looking for a high-energy, driven, and self-motivated individual to join Adobe's Customer Experience Orchestration team as an Associate Business Development Representative supporting our Business Development, Marketing and Sales teams.

This is a net new early in career business development role, and as such, you will be given the opportunity to learn, grow and be successful in understanding the Adobe solutions for the Customer Experience Orchestration business.

In this role, you will be our first line of contact with prospects. You will excel in establishing meaningful conversations with a variety of IT and C-level decision makers in a variety of industries, and you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop target accounts to generate sales-ready meetings and opportunities.
 

Through account-based sales development, you will identify and build sales pipeline that leads to revenue growth. As a starter role in Adobe, you will have the opportunity to work across a number of different industries, business personas and teams. This role is ideal for a highly motivated early-in-career professional who is resilient and keen to learn new skills in building and executing business development prospecting.

Measurement

As a SDR, you will be asked to sit in differing Business Development roles. Your day to day activities will be at times across differing segments within the organisation. In the future, as your success continues, you will be moved to a dedicated account patch, once your area of specialisation is uncovered and developed. The compensation is 70:30, with ramp sales targets initially.

What You’ll Do:

Generate sales pipeline through inbound/outbound prospecting activities via telephone, video, and email

Build awareness into the account base through regular email campaigns, drive attendance to live and online webinars and assist with event/webinar follow ups.

Research accounts, identify key players, generate interest and develop accounts to uncover and develop opportunities for Adobe’s products.

Handle and overcome prospect objections with confidence.

Become a trusted resource and develop positive relationships with your sales ecosystem and peers.

Update CRM, Outreach, and other tools as necessary to ensure the capture of key activity history & ensure a smooth hand-off to the Account Executive as necessary.

Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Adobe's competitive positioning in the marketplace.

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline generating targets to ensure territory revenue objectives and pipeline linearity.

What You Will Need to Succeed

1–3 years of relevant experience.

A track record of achieving measurable sales goals, in IT, or any other sales-focused environment.

Attention to detail to support accurate entry and management of lead data in a CRM system as required.

Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing and presentation skills

An interest in sales prospecting tactics and technologies.

An interest in marketing technologies.

An interest in developing and learning new skills.

Motivated by individual and team achievement.

Highly organised with the ability to work in fast-paced environment.

Resilience.

Translate Strategy into measurable outcomes

Executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders. 

Structured, analytical thinker with strong judgment and decisiveness.

Skilled at driving change across matrixed organizations without direct authority. 

Education 

Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent operational experience strongly preferred.

We’re looking for a Sr Staff Designer to help define how intelligence, automation, and creativity come together in the next generation of creative workflows. Love experimenting with new technologies? Curious about how AI can expand creativity? This might be your next challenge!

This position is ideal for someone who is energized by strategic operational work, cross‑functional coordination, and building systems that help an organization run effectively at scale.

Why This Role Matters

This role ensures that the Sales Operations & Enablement organization runs as a coordinated, aligned, and high‑performing system. By driving planning, operational discipline, and structured execution, the Business Operations Lead enables the team to focus on the work that accelerates impact and strengthens organizational effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

Business & Organizational Operations

Lead the operating rhythm for the Sales Ops & Enablement organization, including planning cycles, leadership reviews, performance tracking, and operational governance.

Drive goal‑setting, OKR development, milestone planning, and KPI measurement for the organization.

Foster a culture of alignment, focus, and operational excellence.

Collaborate with the Communications Lead to ensure coordination on timing and alignment for key organizational moments—without owning communications directly.

Support rollout and adoption of new programs, systems, and operating practices across the organization.

This role is crucial in driving revenue growth through strategic cross-sell and upsell initiatives. The incumbent would be responsible for helping the customers adopt the solution with ease, optimizing their product experience and guiding them to internal support teams if need be. This role entails nurturing and co-selling with partners where a rep. will be responsible for the entire gambit of account management like Strategic Account planning, Client Need assessment, building connects strategies with multiple stakeholders, conducting extensive account reviews, driving growth through cross-selling / upselling, and building long-term relationships. KPIs for this role will be maximizing Net ARR by growing Gross and mitigating Cancels.

• Drive revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities. You would be responsible for driving Net ARR from the allocated customers for the various Digital Media solutions.

• One of the key measurement metrics will be how well a rep can reach out to the large book of business, building connections and engagements.

• Account manager’s primary goal will be to understand Customer’s business needs / pain points on document workflows & creative content creation, offer solutions, and foster long-term partnerships that drive business growth.

• Managing the opportunity pipeline from week to week, providing accurate and timely updates to management on progress and outlook. As an Account manager, you will be responsible and measured on how well you are executing on the key products such as Acrobat, Acrobat AI, Express, Acrobat Sign

Role Summary

Are you a dreamer with a passion for crafting outstanding user experiences? At Adobe, we are looking for a Digital Strategist who will play a pivotal role in developing and delivering user-centered experience strategies that drive measurable business outcomes. This is your opportunity to work on world-class projects, collaborate with highly skilled talent, and make a significant impact!

The Digital Strategist, Customer Experience (UX Strategy) focuses on UX strategy, systems thinking, and visual storytelling. You will turn customer insights, data, and business goals into clear experience guidance and engaging visual stories. Collaborating with senior strategists, UX and visual designers, researchers, and cross-functional partners, you will help develop the experience vision and direction—not only deciding what to build but explaining why it matters and how it brings value. You will communicate ideas using experience models, journey maps, frameworks, and diagrams that align partners and guide progress.
Success in this role means making complex experience ecosystems clear, practical, and scalable, while explicitly linking experience decisions to performance, feasibility, and business impact.

What You’ll Do

Apply human-centered thinking and UX strategy principles to frame experience challenges and opportunities across journeys, channels, and platforms.

Convert research, data, and business context into experience principles, journey frameworks, and strategic recommendations.

Evaluate experience options through a UX lens, considering usability, clarity, accessibility, emotional impact, and long-term scalability.

Build visually structured, decision-ready artifacts such as journey maps, service blueprints, conceptual models, ecosystem diagrams, and experience frameworks.

Demonstrate strong visual judgment—clear hierarchy, layout, flow, and narrative structure that guides understanding.

Partner closely with UX and visual designers, ensuring strategy intent is reflected in experience and build execution.

Translate ambiguous business and experience questions into structured UX strategy approaches, including hypotheses, options, and implications.

Make informed assumptions when information is incomplete, clearly articulating trade-offs, risks, and UX implications.

Balance experience vision with practical considerations such as delivery complexity, operational impact, and performance outcomes.

Communicate strategy through clear, visual storytelling, tailored to executives, designers, product teams, and technical partners.

Link experience decisions to business value, customer outcomes, and measurable success criteria.

Share progress, insights, and recommendations in a concise, structured way that enables confident decision-making.

Portfolio Expectations

Candidates should be prepared to share a portfolio of UX strategy work that demonstrates how they think, structure problems, and communicate visually. This role does not require high-fidelity UI or visual build execution, but it does require strong experience-build thinking and visual communication.
Your portfolio should show examples of:

Journey maps, experience frameworks, service blueprints, or ecosystem models

Strategic materials that distinctly transform insights into experience pathways and advice

Visual storytelling that simplifies complex systems, platforms, or organizational challenges

Work that connects user needs, business goals, and experience outcomes

Slides or artifacts built for executive or collaborator alignment, not just internal analysis

We’re especially interested in seeing:

How you structure ambiguity

How you visually explain experience strategy

How your work influenced decisions, alignment, or execution

Job Description

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Account Executive to drive opportunity within our Solution-led business. You will be responsible for exceeding sales targets through the sale of Adobe's leading edge Digital Experience solutions within our Enterprise segment. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue from an account base of our largest customers within Solution-Led, providing strategic partnership to help them solve their biggest challenges. You will work across the Adobe ecosystem to eliminate barriers and accelerate time to sale. The ideal candidate is someone with a competitive mentality who thrives on being on the front lines, prospecting, consultative value selling, closing deals, and winning!

What you'll Do

Drive sales for Adobe’s Customer Experience Orchestration solutions by delivering targeted sales strategies, overcoming objections, and creating compelling business cases to expand adoption within an existing Adobe customer base.

Manage your time and territory by prioritizing accounts, aligning activities for maximum impact, and balancing short-term wins with long-term growth opportunities.

Collaborate within a matrixed ecosystem including internal sales and cross-functional teams (Product, Marketing, Legal, Finance) to align resources, enhance value, and deliver a unified customer experience.

Build and expand executive relationships through thoughtful, ongoing engagement — gaining access to senior decision-makers (e.g., VP, SVP, CxO), leveraging champions, and crafting shareable, value-driven communications.

Stay informed on customer needs, competitive dynamics, and market trends, contributing thought leadership and sharing insights across peers and teams.

Act as a long-term strategic advisor by diagnosing business problems, tailoring and aligning Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration solutions to their strategic objectives, and delivering persuasive cases that clearly demonstrate the impact of our value.

Use data and insights to manage complex sales cycles, guide strategic business reviews, ensure forecast accuracy, and consistently progress deals across your territory.

Perform outbound selling activities, conduct account-level research, and collaborate with Partner and Marketing teams to generate demand, build credibility with customers, and create a compelling vision to drive urgency and justify investment for your customers.

Build and maintain a strong pipeline of customer opportunities / revenue generation and exceed targets.

What you need to succeed

Resilience, adaptability, and strong negotiation skills.

Proactiveness, competitiveness, and ability to exceed sales targets.

Awareness of trends and customer-focused value selling.

Persuasiveness, clear communication, and effective presentation.

Trust, collaboration, and account management.

Self-awareness, open-mindedness, and curiosity.

Focus, flexibility, and drive.

Bachelor's Degree and 1 year of experience OR 3 years of equivalent practical experience.

Minimum 5 years of experience in SaaS sales.

3+ years of experience with marketing technology solutions and/or consultative platform sales preferred.

The Forward Deployed Engineer - Creative Technologist is a hands-on technical innovator who works with our AI technology partners to rapidly prototype and deploy AI-powered creative solutions that maximize value realization from Generative AI investments. You will be embedded within client environments, building custom plugins, automating creative workflows, and creating novel integrations that demonstrate the transformative potential of generative AI in content creation.

Working at the intersection of design and engineering, you will own technical systems end-to-end—from rapid prototyping through production deployment. Your expertise in Adobe App Builder, Node.js, Python, and AI technologies will enable you to quickly analyze client challenges, architect innovative solutions, and build working prototypes that capture field-proven use cases.

Key Responsibilities
1. Rapid Prototyping & Technical Innovation

Rapidly Prototype & Iterate: Create proof-of-concept implementations demonstrating AI integration possibilities

Adobe Ecosystem Development: Build and iterate on AI-powered creative tools and plugins using Adobe App Builder, UXP, and Creative SDK frameworks

Custom Tooling: Develop custom Photoshop and Figma plugins that automate complex creative workflows and integrate AI capabilities

Agile Execution: Operate within Agile/Scrum methodologies to deliver iterative value, adapting quickly to evolving client feedback and requirements

2. API Configuration & System Integration

API Orchestration: Write JSON configuration files and orchestrate complex API calls to create seamless automation sequences between disparate systems.

Hands-on Troubleshooting: deeply investigate API requests/responses, debug connectivity issues using browser consoles and proxy tools, and optimize integration performance for low latency

Integrate cutting-edge AI technologies (LLMs, diffusion models, RAG pipelines) into creative workflows and production systems

Build and optimize AI agent frameworks using tools like AutoGen, LangChain, and LlamaIndex for creative workflow automation

Implement multimodal AI processing capabilities for text, image, video, and audio content creation and manipulation

3. Client-Embedded Technical Leadership

Operate within client environments with high autonomy, managing complex technical workstreams from ideation through deployment

Drive technical requirements gathering and solution architecture for AI-powered creative systems

Analyze unfamiliar legacy backend systems and devise novel integration solutions

4. Product Innovation & Knowledge Transfer

Capture field-proven use cases and technical patterns, feeding insights back to Product & Engineering teams

Establish frameworks and mental models that inspire autonomous innovation across engineering and creative teams

Document technical discoveries and prototype learnings to accelerate future implementations

Mentor client technical teams on AI integration best practices and advanced automation techniques

What You Bring

7-8 years of experience in creative technology, full-stack engineering, or technical product development

Experience using rapid prototyping, structured testing, and continuous refinement as core working methods. A portfolio demonstrating a history of rapid app/tool development is highly recommended.

Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud APIs, SDK, CEP frameworks, Firefly Services APIs, and building custom plugins/extensions (ex: Photoshop, Figma, etc.) Workfront Fusion experience a plus

Experience with full-stack development, modern web technologies, API integration, cloud deployment

Hands-on experience with LLMs, diffusion models, RAG pipelines, vector databases, prompt engineering, model optimization, and AI agent frameworks with multimodal processing

Deep understanding of creative workflows, content production pipelines, and design tool ecosystems

Demonstrated ability to own complex systems end-to-end from ideation through deployment

Proven ability to navigate seamlessly across disciplines (ML, animation pipelines, plugin architecture, generative models)

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to navigate ambiguity and evolving requirements

Willingness to travel within the US (10–20%)

The Opportunity 

Adobe is seeking a bold, strategic leader to define and scale our global strategy for the Technology sector. This role spans software, hardware, semiconductor, electronics, cloud and platform companies, Professional Services, and Agency Networks, often with complex B2B, B2C and B2B2C value chains. 

As the Global Industry Strategy Lead, Technology, you will define Adobe’s industry point-of-view (POV) and translate it into a globally aligned, cross-cloud (Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration + Adobe Creativity & Productivity) go-to-market (GTM) strategy. You will partner deeply across Sales, Product Management, Product Marketing, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, and Marketing to unify Adobe’s narrative, accelerate pipeline, and drive repeatable impact across regions. 

 

This role sits within the Digital Strategy Group (DSG) and plays a critical part in Adobe’s Global Industry Strategy team—responsible for shaping Adobe’s industry vision, value propositions, and high-impact strategic motions at scale. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Develop Adobe’s POV for the Future of Technology 

Lead the creation of a differentiated, forward-looking POV that demonstrates how Adobe enables transformation across the entire Technology customer and partner ecosystem. 
This includes: 

· Demonstrating value across product-led growth motions, partner ecosystems, B2B commerce models, cloud & platform engagement, and customer lifecycle experiences 

· Shaping strategic use cases across data, personalization, content supply chain modernization, global marketing operations, and unified measurement 

· Developing reusable global assets: frameworks, POVs, use-case libraries, playbooks, industry demos, and Bill of Materials (BOM) content for sales, DSG, and partners 

You will collaborate closely with strategists, technologists, data scientists, partner organizations, and field teams to define what “great” looks like—and how Adobe helps Technology companies get there. 

 

2. Sharpen and Coordinate a Global GTM Strategy 

Translate the industry POV into a globally aligned, high-impact GTM motion. 
You will: 

· Align strategy across sales plays, product requirements, partner motions, and regional needs 

· Ensure GTM motions scale globally—not tied to a single region, account list, or narrow set of priorities 

· Provide input to product and engineering teams around emerging trends, customer patterns, and required capabilities 

· Collaborate with partner teams to define joint assets, accelerators, and co-sell strategies 

This role ensures Adobe shows up to the Technology industry with one coordinated voice and one unified strategy. 

 

3. Drive Influence Through High-Leverage Thought Leadership 

Focus on fewer, more strategic deliverables that scale across the business. 
This includes: 

· Authoring frameworks, POVs, and industry narratives used across Adobe’s global ecosystem 

· Identifying where Adobe has a differentiated “right to win” in Technology 

· Codifying insights from customer work into reusable global assets, such as customer success stories 

· Monitoring industry trends to ensure Adobe stays ahead of market shifts, emerging business models, and new experience expectations 

The impact of your work will be measured by clarity, adoption, and influence—not volume. 

 

4. Engage Executives Strategically (primarily 1:many, and 1:1 for top priority accounts) 

Represent Adobe as a trusted advisor in Technology executive settings. 
You will: 

· Lead Adobe’s involvement in industry events, executive forums, and roundtables 

· Present compelling, strategic thought leadership to C-suite audiences 

· Support high-value pursuits, Customer Experience Center (CEC) briefings, and strategic account engagements 

· Sponsor and cultivate key customers, enabling case studies, customer keynotes, and repeatable stories of impact 

Your goal is to maximize industry influence at scale while supporting the strategic deals that matter most. 

 

5. Amplify Global Marketing and Upskill the Ecosystem 

Partner with global marketing and field teams to amplify Adobe’s Technology leadership. 

 
You will: 

· Shape global campaigns, messaging, and event strategies 

· Guide positioning for AI-driven innovation in Technology 

· Enable DSG, field teams, SCs, BDRs, and partners with reusable training, demos, and toolkits 

· Build a consistent global drumbeat of Adobe-led thought leadership 

This role turns Adobe’s Technology capabilities into a cohesive, globally recognized story. 

 

What You Need to Succeed 

Success is defined by the clarity you create, the global alignment you drive, and the measurable impact on Adobe’s Technology business. 

Ideal candidates bring: 

· 10+ years of experience in the Technology sector (software, hardware, cloud, semiconductor, electronics, strategy consulting, or platform provider) 

· Deep understanding of digital transformation within Technology: customer data, AI/ML, personalization, content supply chain, omnichannel experiences, B2B engagement, product-led growth, and measurement 

· Proven success building and executing strategic transformation programs 

· Experience aligning GTM strategies across sales, product, and partner teams, ideally with global scope 

· Ability to distill complex topics into clear, scalable frameworks and POVs 

· Outstanding executive presence with extensive experience presenting to C-suite audiences 

· Excellent storytelling, narrative development, and written communication skills 

· Highly collaborative mindset with the ability to influence in matrixed environments 

· Comfort navigating ambiguity with an entrepreneurial, opportunity-driven mindset 

· Willingness to travel up to 40%

· Open to candidates in PST, MST and PST time zones, with a strong preference for PST

 

Why This Role Matters 

Technology is one of the most rapidly evolving industries in the world—shaped by AI, cloud-driven engagement, platform ecosystems, new monetization models, and a global focus on speed, scale, and customer-centricity. Adobe’s customers need a trusted guide who can help them reimagine digital experiences across this landscape.

The Professional Development Specialist will play a critical role within the Customer Solutions & Innovation Team and is responsible for designing, implementing, and evaluating training programs to enhance employee skills and organizational performance. They assess training needs, create educational materials, facilitate workshops, and measure program effectiveness to drive continuous learning, productivity, career growth, and high-quality customer delivery. The Professional Development Strategist must be a proactive problem-solver with strong customer-first thinking, attention to detail, and an eye for user experience.

What You’ll Do:

Develop Professional Enablement Strategy: Develop and implement professional enablement strategy that aligns with business objectives and addresses both internal and external customer needs.

Needs Assessment: Identify skill gaps and training needs through surveys, interviews, meeting with managers, and leveraging the voice of the customer. 

Curriculum Development: Create and update enablement content, including online courses and training documentation. 

Instruction & Facilitation: Design workshops, onboarding sessions, and select & facilitate instructional sessions of outside professional enablement courses. 

Evaluation & Analysis: Analyze training effectiveness, adjusting programs for performance.

Operational management: Develop intake, design and creation processes. Maintain schedules and status reporting of enablement creation progress. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Delivery, Solution Customer Engagement, Strategy & Readiness, and Global Operations to gain alignment or inputs on enablement when needed.

Voice of the Customer (VoC): Use customer feedback and insights, in addition to research on industry trends and audience behavior, and customer feedback to inform enablement planning and prioritization that directly enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

Bachelor's degree in Education, Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related field.

10+ years of proven experience in instructional design, or designing programs at scale, preferably in a SaaS or technology company.

A portfolio demonstrating excellence in professional development strategy, enablement design and creation. Understanding Program Management a plus.

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional, agile team environment.

Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the organization.

Experience in a customer-centric or customer solutions environment is highly preferred.

Proficiency in document development tools including PowerPoint, InDesign, Adobe Express.

Experience with technical delivery of the Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration product suite is a plus.

Increased Time to Value

Increased automations in delivery processes

Increased asset reusability

Defined framework for cross training strategy

The Integrated Go-to-Market (IGTM) team advises Adobe’s senior leadership on strategies for improved market success and customer impact across all lines of business and geographies. Our focus is translating strategy into action by aligning teams, programs, and execution across the Enterprise go‑to‑market motion. By improving coordination across functions, IGTM helps the field scale more effectively while reducing friction for customers and internal teams. Today, Adobe is at the forefront of enabling our customers’ digital transformation and new experience-led business models. 

The Opportunity 

As a Senior IGTM Strategist (Sales Strategy & Execution), you will drive cross‑functional alignment across the global Enterprise, partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Partner teams, Pre‑Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Success to translate integrated go‑to‑market strategies into cohesive programs and execution plans. You will help operate the Enterprise GTM system by identifying where execution is breaking down, framing clear problem statements, and mobilizing the right owners to deliver systemic fixes that scale globally. 

 

This role requires strong judgment, comfort navigating ambiguity, and the ability to influence through shared ownership. You will regularly frame decisions for leaders by presenting options, tradeoffs, and a recommended path, and you will escalate GTM risks and breakdowns early with a clear ask and plan to resolve them. 

 

 

What you’ll do 

Diagnose GTM execution breakdowns by synthesizing data and field input into clear problem statements, root-cause hypotheses, and recommended actions. 

Escalate risks and decisions early with concise options and tradeoffs and drive alignment to a decision and a path forward. 

Lead cross-functional workstreams that deliver systemic fixes, and ensure solutions scale across regions 

Translate strategy into repeatable execution mechanisms such as operating rhythms, governance, templates, and playbooks that improve consistency and adoption. 

Clarify roles, dependencies, and success measures across the ecosystem so teams operate as one integrated motion across the customer lifecycle. 

Establish insight-to-action loops that track commitments to completion and confirm that fixes are adopted and improving outcomes over time. 

 

What you need to succeed 

5+ years of enterprise marketing or SaaS experience in Strategy, Sales Operations, Marketing, Consulting, or Pre-Sales 

GTM Experience – Strong GTM experience and understanding of a SaaS customer lifecycle, sales cycles, and the factors that drive sales success. 

Problem Solving – Outstanding problem solving and analytical skills, including comfort developing hypotheses and crafting recommendations focused on the biggest opportunities. 

Workstream Ownership – Experience leading cross-functional workstreams, aligning stakeholders, managing competing priorities, and driving progress through influence rather than authority. 

Collaboration & Communication – Excellent communication skills, including the ability to clearly convey complex ideas verbally and in writing, and to frame decisions for senior leaders. 

Project Management - Strong project management skills and the ability to prioritize and balance multiple initiatives in a dynamic and evolving work environment. 

Desirable but not essential 

MBA or equivalent advanced degree 

Experience designing or operating cross‑functional GTM models across Marketing, Sales, Partners, and Professional Services 

Experience leading companywide launches, transformations, or execution frameworks that require sustained cross functional alignment 

Background in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, or strategic Enablement roles focused on operating model design, adoption, and execution effectiveness 

Technology sales or management consulting experience

Data Analytics is one of the rapidly growing fields in GPU accelerated computing.
